Resume a paused job, whatever the reason; the backfill is checked again (422 simulate_all.backfill_incomplete). Hours and disk rules still apply at the next look. 404 simulate_all.no_active_job, 409 simulate_all.not_paused
Cancel the job; chunks not done are never run, stored runs stay. 404 simulate_all.no_active_job

get.summary: What starting a replay on a stored run would mean, before the owner clicks: the baseline, the knobs offered (exit parameters and slippage upward), the next trial number and the improvement it must show, the folds the data has and the best possible outcome (Inconclusive when fewer than 6), the measured replay time (not_evaluable until a job measured one), and the starts left today. Read only. 422 learning.invalid, 404 learning.run_not_found
The replay jobs, newest first (limit 1 to 200, default 20), with their state, stage, progress and the measured replay time. 422 learning.invalid

One replay job: state, stage, progress, the candidate run and the experiment it produced, the measured replay time with the instrument count and whether other heavy jobs ran, and the limits. 404 experiments.job_not_found

post.summary: Stop a job: a queued one at once, a running one at its next safe point between instruments (nothing is stored, no ledger row, not a trial). Needs the session and the CSRF token; no password, because stopping is the safe direction. 202, 409 experiments.job_not_cancellable, 404 experiments.job_not_found

Save one research table the Reports screens show (report-groups, report-pivot, report-what-works, report-equity, report-trades) as a CSV file: the same numbers as the GET of the same query, with the evidence block (basis with the charge-sheet confirmation if net, population rule, as-of, runs, unavailable inputs, limits, row count and hash) as # comment lines before the table and a closing line after it. A figure is three columns (number, state, reason); a non-value has no number. The file is never cut: a table over 100,000 rows or 25 MB is refused (413 exports.too_large) with the sentence to narrow the filters. Needs a session, the CSRF token and the capability exports (OFF by default; switching it ON asks the password), at most 6 a minute and one at a time. Body {format:'csv', query:{...the ReportQueryInput fields of the screen}}. The name of the file is made by the server (xd-<kind>-<yyyyMMdd>-<8 hex of the table hash>.csv). One audit row (ReportExported: kind, format, rows, bytes, how many filters) and no content in any log. 403 capabilities.off, 422 exports.kind_unknown, exports.format_unknown, reports.invalid and the other report refusals of the same query, 409 reports.run_overlap or reports.mixed_basis, 404 reports.not_found, 413 exports.too_large, 429 auth.rate_limited, 500 exports.audit_failed.

get.summary: The learning changelog, newest first (limit 1 to 200, default 50; subjectKind cell or model; subject one cell key or model:ID): what changed, by whom or what, why, before and after references and evidence ids. Rows are never changed; a revert is a row that points at the one it reverts. Empty before the first record. 422 learning.invalid

Where a cell is (query cell=strategy|tf|side|style|exit|regime), replayed from its changelog rows, with the moves the lifecycle allows next. A record only: nothing acts on a cell's state before paper data and live exist. 422 learning.invalid
One changelog row. 404 changelog.not_found

The audit, newest first, merged from the sign-in, account, approval, plan, autonomy, learning and charge-sheet confirmation records (limit 1 to 200, default 50; from/to India dates, default the last 30 days; source, category, kind, outcome, actor take comma lists; account; q 3 to 64 characters, matched against the redacted summary only). Cursor paging. A record that cannot be read is named in sources. 422 audit.invalid
One audit entry with its detail fields (id as in the list, such as auth:<uuid> or approval:12). A sign-in entry adds the IP address and user agent. 404 audit.not_found
Counts of the window per record, category and outcome, with the same per-record read states. 422 audit.invalid
The kinds each record can hold, with category and outcome, for the filter lists.

The hypotheses (one knob each, from the owner or the grid), newest first, each in its current state (proposed, approved, running, judged, accepted, rejected, expired); optional state filter, limit 1 to 200 (default 50). Empty before the first. 422 learning.invalid
One hypothesis with its history, the states it may move to and the experiment that judged it. Accepting records a verdict only; applying a change is the owner's own act. 404 hypotheses.not_found

The lessons (a problem a replayed monitor found, the fix linked and the stored result), newest first, each in its current state (open, linked, closed, dismissed); optional state filter, limit 1 to 200 (default 50). Empty before the first. 422 learning.invalid
One lesson with its history, the states it may move to and the before and after numbers of its closing. Linking or closing applies nothing. 404 lessons.not_found

The plans, newest session first, each in its current state; optional session date and account filters, limit 1 to 200 (default 50). Empty before the first. No order is placed by any plan. 422 plans.invalid

What the owner should know about the plan for the notification bell, derived at read time from the stored plan record, runs and fills: a plan awaiting review with the minutes to its stored cutoff, the nightly run that failed closed (gate and reason), tickets that lapsed, tickets armed or invalidated at pre-open, and approved tickets whose fills are not matched yet. Each item has an in-app route and no command, carries counts and no symbol, and is gone once the stored state changes. Read only; in-app only

One plan with its tickets (primary, reserve, rejected with reasons and evidence), size per account, the states they may move to and the trail of every state change. Armed means watched, never an order. 404 plans.not_found

The daily context of one ticket: the last 10 to 250 (default 60) daily bars up to the plan's last closed session, adjusted by the corporate actions applied as of that session, the ticket's indicative levels as stored (source 'none' when it has none) and its rule texts. A symbol that matches no instrument or more than one active share returns resolution not_found or ambiguous and no bars. No bar after the session is ever returned. Read only. 404 plans.not_found, plans.item_not_found; 422 plans.invalid

The grade of every ticket of a plan (primary, reserve, rejected), each walked through the stored bars of its session and labelled 'simulated on plan prices', with the day's top-1/3/5/all curves and decision groups. A ticket without a stored grade is pending. Read only. 404 plans.not_found

The auto-journal of a plan: each approved ticket's fills the portfolio sync stored (matched by account, instrument, side and day), the fill grade ('realised fills, not simulated') beside the plan-price grade ('simulated on plan prices'), and the day's discretionary fills apart. Fills are only read; nothing is an order. 404 plans.not_found

Top-1/3/5/all curves by rank, primary versus reserve versus rejected, and the owner's decisions (approved, modified, rejected, lapsed, undecided) over the graded plans of an optional date range, with sample-size notes. Labelled 'simulated on plan prices'. Read only. 422 plans.invalid

The recorded attempts of the nightly pipeline, newest planned session first: published (with the plan) or failed closed (with the gate and the reason). Optional planned-session date, limit 1 to 200 (default 50). Read only. 422 plans.invalid

The P7 phase check from stored records: the last ten trading sessions (scheduled or manual run, gates, published or failed closed, tickets, manual runs), then each acceptance criterion as MET, NOT MET or NOT EVALUABLE with its numbers, the services and owner switches that are still off, and the honest limits. The exit is never MET on fewer than ten consecutive scheduled sessions. Optional 'through' planned-session date. Read only; writes nothing. 422 plans.invalid

The paper trades captured from armed tickets, newest entry first, one per ticket and account at the owner's quantity, each with its exit (instant, filled price, reason, rupees gross and net, R) once the replay closes it. Optional entry day range, account and epoch, limit 1 to 200 (default 50). Every response says: simulated on the official 1-minute bars; no order was placed or exists. Read only. 422 paper.invalid

The sessions the paper capture processed, newest first, one row per session and run, empty sessions included: what it saw, wrote, left pending and found inconsistent. Limit 1 to 200 (default 50). Read only. 422 paper.invalid

The paper accounts (Trading role, mode paper) with their ledger derived from the stored paper trades: realised gross, charges and result (labelled gross, or after the stored sheet and not confirmed, never net as a result of record), equity = capital + realised result, funds (no leverage), open risk percent, unrealised (unavailable, never 0, when a mark is), last-session result and closed-trade drawdown. Optional epoch (default the newest). Read only; simulated, no order exists. 404 paper.not_found, 422 paper.invalid

The open paper positions of one account with their marks (the close of the last closed session, or unavailable with the reason and no unrealised figure) and its closed trades, newest exit first. Read only. 404 paper.not_found

The realised-equity line of one paper account: one point per trading session from the epoch's start (capital plus the realised result of the exits up to that session). Optional from and to (sessions), at most 400 sessions. Read only. 404 paper.not_found, 422 paper.invalid

Compares the derived ledger of one paper account with sums read straight from the stored rows (exits sum, entries without exit, exit before entry, entries of an account that is not paper now): status ok or each difference. Read only. 404 paper.not_found

The measurement epochs, newest first: kind, first session, end (the next epoch's start), configuration fingerprint (short), counted and straddle entries, risk-down changes and unexplained changes. Epochs are never pooled. Read only.
One epoch with the configuration changes recorded under it and the owner's notes. Read only. 404 paper.not_found

The configuration now with the class rule of every component, the last snapshot's hash, the differences not yet captured (each marked would restart the count or noted only) and the learning services enabled during an epoch (blockers). A preview: nothing is stored. Read only.

The recorded configuration changes, newest first, with class, before, after, effect and explanation (hypothesis:id, changelog:id or unexplained). Optional epoch, limit 1 to 200 (default 50). Read only. 422 paper.invalid

Accepted hypotheses that no change names: age, cell, knob, from, to and experiment. Accepted means judged better offline; nothing was applied; applying it starts a new epoch. The system never applies or reorders it. Read only.
The stored weekly paper reviews, newest week first (optional epoch; limit 1 to 52, default 12). Read only. 422 paper.invalid

The stored weekly paper review of an ISO week (2026-W43) and epoch (default the newest): the text exactly as it was built, and its sections. Opens with 'Paper only: no order was placed and none exists.' Read only. 404 paper.not_found, 422 paper.invalid

A weekly paper review built now from stored records and not stored (week=2026-W43, default this week; optional epoch). An older week is the state as of today, and says so. Read only. 404 paper.not_found, 422 paper.invalid

The discipline report of a window (epoch, from, to; default the whole epoch up to the last closed session): the seven categories of the primary tickets (they add up to the primary count), what skipping and resizing cost in R with n and state, added real fills, and the paper execution gap. No composite score. Read only. 404 paper.not_found, 422 paper.invalid

The counted paper trades of an epoch against a composition-matched bootstrap of the backtest trades known before the epoch started: the paper mean with its own 90% interval against the 5th to 95th percentile band (below, within or above), the paper's largest fall against the 90th percentile of the same number of backtest trades, the two exit statistics as verdicts (met, not_met, not_evaluable: they need 60 counted trades and costs the owner confirmed), an early warning, the fan of cumulative R, the cells and the plan-price sensitivity beside. Every figure is a state and a number only for a value or provisional figure. Optional epoch (default the newest) and draws 1000 to 100000 (default 10000). Deterministic, read only; simulated, no order exists. 404 paper.not_found, 422 paper.invalid

The decay monitor of one strategy's forward series (strategy=<id>): non-overlapping windows of graded trades against mu_ref - z x sigma x sqrt(DEFF / n + 1 / N_ref), twice in a row, the P6-09 CUSUM on the same series, a by-quarter table, and the kill-rule evaluations with their numbers (cost stress, drawdown, decay twice in a row, the CF-09 failure boundary as a proposal-only input). The edge series (graded shadow trades) is the primary reading with the P10 behavioural series beside it. Report only: nothing is proposed, stored or paused and no order exists; a figure without a source says unavailable and why. 404 paper.not_found when the strategy has neither a shadow edge candidate nor a counted paper trade in the current epoch, 400 paper.invalid

Is the learning loop helping? The three arms on the same candidates (frozen, retrained, no model) as paired day-cluster differences, the learning curve, the reliability slope and the decision-quality lift. Report only; each section whose input has no source yet says unavailable and why (today none has one). No order exists.

The readiness system card (the minimum of the integrity and the weighted mean of the strategy scores, equal weights labelled when the plan exposes no risk share) and one line per Lab strategy at its latest version, weakest first: score, label, weakest sub-score, rows passed of 15, hard fails, gates R and S. Derived on every read, no order. An input that does not exist is unavailable, which is never a pass.

The scorecard of one strategy version: the 15-row edge checklist (value, threshold, producer, pass / fail / unavailable), the six sub-scores with what would move each, the hard fails by name, the label, gates R and S with the rows that stop them, what the card is waiting for, the settings hash and the newest daily snapshots. Derived on every read. 400 confidence.readiness_invalid, 404 confidence.scorecard_not_found
The readiness enforce switch (OFF when no row is stored) and the text and hash of the thresholds. Read only.

put.summary: Switch confidence.readiness.enforce (OFF by default; no row means OFF) as the owner; appends an audited row with the owner as actor. ON makes a failed readiness gate refuse the cell move it judges (Candidate to Paper, the owner's re-enable of a paused cell, Paper to Active) with 409 confidence.gate_failed and the failing rows; OFF only warns and records the result. Needs a session, the CSRF token and the password in the body, checked on EVERY change, ON and OFF alike (OFF removes a refusal). 403 auth.step_up_required (no password), 401 auth.invalid_credentials, 423 auth.locked, 400 confidence.reason_invalid, 429 auth.rate_limited

post.summary: Record, as the owner, the result of a verify-pack --gate run for a strategy version (insert only; the owner is the actor). Row 15's P3-09 20-trade term reads the newest record: PASS over at least 20 trades is a pass, any other status is a fail, no record is unavailable (a fail). Needs a session, the CSRF token and the password in the body. 403 auth.step_up_required, 401 auth.invalid_credentials, 423 auth.locked, 400 confidence.readiness_invalid or confidence.reason_invalid, 404 confidence.scorecard_not_found, 429 auth.rate_limited

get.summary: The kill proposals, newest first (state proposed, applied or dismissed; strategy; limit 1 to 200, default 50), each with its rule, numbers, the cells it would pause and who applied it, with the automatic setting (default OFF) and the thresholds beside them. Read only. 400 paper.invalid

post.summary: Apply a kill proposal as the owner: every cell it names that is still Paper or Active moves to Paused through the lifecycle, with a changelog row carrying the rule, the numbers and the settings hash. Needs the owner's session and the CSRF token. Applying twice changes nothing twice. It places no order. 404 confidence.proposal_not_found, 409 confidence.proposal_closed, 409 confidence.proposal_dismissed_during_apply (dismissed meanwhile; the cells it paused stay paused)

Dismiss a kill proposal as the owner: records the owner (from the session) and the reason, once, and changes no cell and no lifecycle state; a dismissed proposal can never be applied. Needs a session, the CSRF token and a fresh password in the body. Dismissing twice changes nothing twice (alreadyDismissed true, the first actor and reason stand). It places no order. 403 auth.step_up_required (no password), 401 auth.invalid_credentials, 423 auth.locked, 429 auth.rate_limited, 400 confidence.reason_invalid, 404 confidence.proposal_not_found, 409 confidence.proposal_applied

put.summary: Switch confidence.kill.auto (OFF by default; no row means OFF) ON or OFF as the owner; appends an audited row with the owner as actor. ON lets the daily decay-monitor pause the cells of a strategy when a kill rule fires, recorded as actor auto with the setting row, never as an owner approval; the CF-09 failure boundary is never executed automatically. Needs a session, the CSRF token and the password in the body, checked on EVERY change. 403 auth.step_up_required (no password), 401 auth.invalid_credentials, 423 auth.locked, 400 confidence.reason_invalid, 429 auth.rate_limited

post.summary: Re-enable a paused cell (Paused to Paper; the key is the URL-encoded cell key) as the owner. Never automatic and never to Active. Needs a session, the CSRF token and a fresh password in the body. When a kill proposal paused the cell, every rule that fired must hold now and none may fire, else 409 confidence.rule_not_cleared (the spec's rule_cleared problem, named to read as what it says); a rule that cannot be evaluated is not a pass. The answer always warns that the CF-11 gates (R and S) are not enforcing yet. 403 auth.step_up_required (no password), 401 auth.invalid_credentials, 423 auth.locked, 403 confidence.owner_only, 409 confidence.cell_not_paused, 400 confidence.reason_invalid, 422 learning.invalid

get.summary: The rollback proposals, newest first (state proposed, applied or dismissed; modelId; limit 1 to 200, default 50), each with its trigger (the P6-09 calibration detector or rolling band detector), numbers, whether the previous champion still qualifies and who applied it, with the three ML switches (all default OFF) beside them. Read only. 422 learning.invalid

post.summary: Apply a rollback proposal as the owner: the champion moves to challenger (shadow) through the registry's designation, with a changelog row carrying the trigger, the numbers and the settings hash. Needs the owner's session and the CSRF token (it lowers reliance on ML). Applying twice changes nothing twice. It never re-promotes the previous champion: there is no champion until the owner names one. 404 learning.rollback_not_found, 409 learning.rollback_closed

put.summary: Change the ML switches ml.influence.enabled, ml.auto_promote and ml.auto_rollback (all OFF by default; no row means OFF) as the owner; each change appends an audited row with the owner as actor. A switch that is not given is left alone. Turning ml.influence.enabled or ml.auto_promote ON needs the session, the CSRF token and the password in the body, checked on EVERY such change (403 auth.step_up_required with no password, 401 auth.invalid_credentials, 423 auth.locked); ml.auto_rollback, and turning any switch OFF, needs the session and the CSRF token only. ON opens nothing alone: influence still needs the predicate's evidence terms, an automatic rollback is recorded as actor auto with the setting row, never as an owner approval, and an automatic promotion needs the promotion rule and the predicate without the switch. 400 learning.ml_settings_invalid, 429 auth.rate_limited

post.summary: Promote a model to champion as the owner, with the P6-08 changelog row. A challenger needs 30 graded candidates over 4 weeks, the paired bootstrap against the champion at 0.95, a P6-12 counterfactual that is not FrozenBetter and the champion rule; a retired previous champion is re-promoted only if its latest evaluation still satisfies the predicate without the owner's switch. A figure that is not available is never a pass (the sources of the first three do not exist yet, so every promotion is refused with the reason). Promotion never turns ml.influence.enabled on. Needs a session, the CSRF token and a fresh password in the body. 403 auth.step_up_required (no password), 401 auth.invalid_credentials, 423 auth.locked, 404 models.not_found, 409 learning.promotion_refused or learning.repromotion_refused or models.not_eligible, 422 learning.invalid

get.summary: The sequential failure test of the paper edge series (graded shadow trades that count for edge, current paper epoch, in session then trade-key order) with the P10 behavioural series beside it: state (monitoring, on_track, caution or failure; failure is latched for the epoch), running sum, boundaries and odds, trades counted, effective n, first crossing, the correlation used, the settings hash and a path summary. scope=system (default) or scope=strategy with strategy=<id>. A flag only: report only, never a pass; the fixed P10 gates still decide a pass. Gaussian model, modelled fills. Read only; no order exists. 404 paper.not_found when no shadow edge candidate exists in the scope, 400 paper.invalid

The shadow record of every nightly candidate (written before the open, graded after the close by the paper replay): raw n and effective n with the correlation used (and whether it is the placeholder), the mean R with a 90% interval and the hit rate for all and by group (primary, reserve, rejected), the behavioural count of P10 and the edge count side by side, the pace once 10 trades are graded, the chain head (sessions, gaps, last digest) and the charge-sheet basis (gross unless the sheet is confirmed), and the sequential failure test line (CF-09: states of the edge and behavioural series and one text line; a flag, never a pass). Always says: modelled fills; no queue, no latency, and that this is a separate count (the P10 exit criterion is untouched). Says so when there are no rows. Read only; no order exists

put.summary: Switch the shadow record (paper.shadow.enabled, OFF by default) ON or OFF as the owner; appends an audited row. Needs a session, the CSRF token and the password in the body, checked on EVERY change (an earlier step-up window does not count and is not used up). ON only allows the services shadow-write and shadow-grade (which also start paused). 401 auth.invalid_credentials, 423 auth.locked, 403 paper.shadow_owner_only, 400 paper.shadow_reason_invalid, 409 paper.shadow_gap (turning ON over missed sessions without acknowledgeGap), 409 paper.shadow_digest_unwritable (turning ON while the digest folder cannot be written), 429 auth.rate_limited

get.summary: The P10 exit judged from stored records for one epoch (default the newest): duration and coverage, counted trades, expectancy within the backtest band after costs, drawdown within the 90th percentile and capture integrity, each MET, NOT MET or NOT EVALUABLE with its facts and blockers; the caveats sit in the label of a MET (exitCriterion); the week lines, every epoch (only the current one is judged), the discipline lines, the P7 phase check, the services and settings, what is never judged here and the honest limits. The report and the printable text. Optional through (rounded down to a trading session; default the last closed session) and epoch. Read only; simulated, no order exists. 404 paper.not_found, 422 paper.invalid

The price crossings of the plan's watched tickets (stop or target level reached, once each), the post-trade prompts with their derived status (open, matched with via journal or trade_on_record, expired_no_fill, ambiguous) and which tickets the owner muted. 'enabled' is false while Planning:TicketAlerts:Enabled is off and the lists are then empty. Alerts only: no order is placed and none exists. Read only. 404 plans.not_found

post.summary: Stop further crossing alerts of one ticket for its session (an insert-only owner act; earlier crossings stay visible; the ticket does not change). Session and CSRF token; the owner is the session. 409 plans.alert_closed after the session, 404 plans.not_found

Hide a crossing or a prompt (noticeId crossing:{id}, prompt:{id} or prompt:{id}:ambiguous, the ambiguous form being its own notice) for 15, 30 or 60 minutes; it reappears once, and can be snoozed three times. Session and CSRF token; insert-only. 422 plans.invalid, 409 plans.snooze_limit or plans.alert_closed (dismissed), 404 plans.not_found

Hide a crossing or a prompt for good (noticeId crossing:{id}, prompt:{id} or prompt:{id}:ambiguous, the ambiguous form being its own notice). Session and CSRF token; insert-only; repeating it changes nothing. 422 plans.invalid, 404 plans.not_found

get.summary: The stored simulation runs a report may use, newest first: strategy, universe, window, costed or gross, the style and exit labels and where they come from, closed and open-at-end trades, whether the default run set takes the run (and why not), and whether net figures are possible at all (unavailable with the reason until the owner has confirmed the stored charge sheet, on the Settings screen, tab Charge sheet). Takes no parameter. Read only.

The headline figures of the whole report population: trades, win rate, average win and loss R, expectancy, profit factor, total R, maximum drawdown, longest loss streak, holding sessions, the shrunk win rate with its credible lower bound. Each figure is a state (value, provisional, insufficient, unavailable, not_evaluable, empty) and carries a number only for a value; the evidence block says what stands behind it. Read only. Takes runs (64-hex keys, comma separated; default the newest run of each strategy and universe), basis (gross or net) and the filters strategy, timeframe, side, style, exit (semicolon separated), basket, symbol, from, to. Strategy, symbol, exit and basket match exactly and case-sensitively. An answer larger than its cap (2,000 groups, 10,000 pivot cells, 200 distributions, 40 curves, 2,000 what-works cells) is refused at the first group past it, never cut; runs holding more than 500,000 closed trades are refused before any trade is read (422 reports.too_large). One report at a time is built; a request waits its turn. 422 reports.invalid, reports.too_large, reports.net_not_confirmed, reports.net_unavailable, reports.dimension_unavailable or reports.double_count; 404 reports.not_found; 409 reports.run_overlap or reports.mixed_basis. Add purpose=training (and simJob=<guid>; default the active, else the newest job) to read a simulate-everything job instead of the evidence runs: a training simulation, not evidence, gross R only, labelled so in evidence.completeness (kind, label, job state, complete, chunks done of total, failed, as-of, the window, the range actually read, whether it was cut before the locked hold-out block and the sentence that says so, stocks asked for with no result, the route of the training record). Only chunks finished at the as-of instant are read; while the job runs, a trades cursor is refused once another chunk finishes, so read again from the first page; filter by stock (symbol) or basket; a larger answer than 500,000 closed trades is refused (422 reports.too_large), never cut. Without purpose=training the answer is the evidence reports as before and no training run is ever in it.

The performance profile of one basket (manual, portfolio or system) from its own stored daily bars against an index: the equal-weight, daily-rebalanced, price-return index rebased to 100 beside the index, volatility, drawdown, beta, alpha (the regression intercept, never a trading result), tracking error, capture, rolling beta, relative strength, breadth, dispersion and correlation inside the basket, contribution, the index by market regime, turnover, ADV20 and capacity, and the median split of the basket's strategy trades. Every figure is a state (value, provisional, insufficient, unavailable, not_evaluable, empty) with a number only for a value, and the membership basis (dated, or a single snapshot with survivorship) and every instrument left out are named. Takes from and to (default the last 252 sessions ending at the newest stored daily bar of the index; window.source says which), index (instrument id; default Nifty 500, or the index the owner chose with PUT /api/reports/basket-benchmark, never the portfolio benchmark; when it is missing from the master or has no bars every figure against it is unavailable with the reason) and membersAsOf (default the window end). A window under 20 sessions or a basket above the instrument cap is 422 reports.invalid; an unknown or archived basket 404 reports.not_found. Read only; the answer is cached by basket, membership, window, index and newest bar. Open to an owner session or to the assistant tool server's read-only service token (bearer, no session; policy AssistantBasketRead, ADR 0267): the token opens no other route.

Two to twelve baskets side by side on relative strength against an index: the return of the relative strength line over 21, 63, 126 and 252 sessions, its rank (1 = strongest) on the longest window most baskets have a value for, the return over the annualised volatility, and the Jaccard overlap of each pair's members. A basket with no value has its state and no rank; when a gap between neighbours is within its noise (indicative, pairwise, uncorrected) separated is false and no order is to be shown; no basket is labelled best. Takes basket (ids, comma separated), from, to and index as the profile does. Read only. 422 reports.invalid; 404 reports.not_found. Open to an owner session or to the assistant tool server's read-only service token (policy AssistantBasketRead, ADR 0267).

Where the edge goes between the plan and the fills: the plan's R, then entry slippage, charges, a remainder 'not attributed' (exit slippage and anything else) and the realised R after the charges the sync recorded, as means over the tickets graded on fills; the counts of approved lines (with fills, uncertain, without fills), triggered tickets that had no fill (outside the chain), the parts not decomposed with the reason, per strategy, and the approvals by kind (owner, auto). Each figure below the minimum number of graded tickets is insufficient with no number. Takes from and to (planned sessions, at most 366 days apart). Read only. 422 reports.invalid.

A page of the closed trades the report counts, in the order of the exits (limit 1 to 1,000, default 100; cursor from the previous page, which belongs to that report and is refused for another): the very set the figures were computed from, open-at-end trades excluded. Every page recomputes the population. There is no lens. Read only. Takes runs (64-hex keys, comma separated; default the newest run of each strategy and universe), basis (gross or net) and the filters strategy, timeframe, side, style, exit (semicolon separated), basket, symbol, from, to. Strategy, symbol, exit and basket match exactly and case-sensitively. An answer larger than its cap (2,000 groups, 10,000 pivot cells, 200 distributions, 40 curves, 2,000 what-works cells) is refused at the first group past it, never cut; runs holding more than 500,000 closed trades are refused before any trade is read (422 reports.too_large). One report at a time is built; a request waits its turn. 422 reports.invalid, reports.too_large, reports.net_not_confirmed, reports.net_unavailable, reports.dimension_unavailable or reports.double_count; 404 reports.not_found; 409 reports.run_overlap or reports.mixed_basis. Add purpose=training (and simJob=<guid>; default the active, else the newest job) to read a simulate-everything job instead of the evidence runs: a training simulation, not evidence, gross R only, labelled so in evidence.completeness (kind, label, job state, complete, chunks done of total, failed, as-of, the window, the range actually read, whether it was cut before the locked hold-out block and the sentence that says so, stocks asked for with no result, the route of the training record). Only chunks finished at the as-of instant are read; while the job runs, a trades cursor is refused once another chunk finishes, so read again from the first page; filter by stock (symbol) or basket; a larger answer than 500,000 closed trades is refused (422 reports.too_large), never cut. Without purpose=training the answer is the evidence reports as before and no training run is ever in it.

One stored simulated trade on its own bars (the replay of the drill-down): the trade facts in adjusted prices, its legs, the costing (figures only for a charge sheet the owner confirmed), the bars of its window at the chosen timeframe built on the server from the 1-minute bars and adjusted for the corporate actions applied now, a check that the stored entry still fits the bars (ok, entry_mismatch, no_bars), the decision-time features stored for the trade (a number only where one is stored) and the evidence block. Takes openAtEnd (default false), timeframe (1m, 5m, 15m, 1h, 1D; default 5m), before and after (sessions around the trade: 0 to 3, or 0 to 60 for 1D). A window above 5,000 bars is refused, never thinned. Read only. 422 reports.invalid or reports.window_too_large; 404 reports.not_found; 409 reports.admission_changed (the run used pre-seam backfilled bars of the instrument and they are no longer admitted on the same basis).

post.summary: Start a replay of the whole system from a chosen date: body from, to (default the last readable session before the hold-out and its embargo), scope {basketIds, instrumentIds} (empty: the stored auto scope, its baskets read as of each session; at most 200 baskets and 2000 instruments), capital (default 1000000), riskProfileId (default the seeded standard profile), costs (null or gross, else the id of a stored charge sheet), versions (start or asOf, default start: today's active versions, labelled hindsight), modes (frozen and/or learning, default frozen; both give two linked runs and a pairId), filtersWithoutHistory and includeResearchCells (both default false; each is a labelled hindsight). 202 with runIds and pairId. 422 replay.invalid (bad input, an empty snapshot, the memory cap); 409 replay.busy (a replay is active, or the 1-minute backfill is incomplete), replay.holdout (to reaches the hold-out; the last allowed date is in the message)

get.summary: The replay runs, newest first (skip, take 1 to 200, default 50): id, created, range, mode, state, completeness, final equity, max drawdown, trial number, costs label, hindsight labels. Read only.

One replay run, readable while it runs: the hindsight labels first, completeness (complete, sessions done of total, the as-of session), the costs label ("before costs (charge sheet not filled, ISS-25)" when gross), trial number, input and result hashes, the settings snapshot, and the figures so far (return, CAGR, max drawdown, Sharpe of daily returns, exposure, trades, hit rate, mean R, contribution per strategy). Read only.
The daily equity, drawdown, cash line and the benchmark (Nifty 500, or the index chosen for the basket reports) rebased to the capital, between from and to (dates, optional). Read only.
One row per stored session between from and to (dates, optional): candidates, taken, blocked by reason, the day's result, equity. Read only.
The full record of one session (yyyy-MM-dd): candidates, ranked list, taken, blocked with reasons, fills, the book open at the close. 404 replay.session_not_found while it is not stored. Read only.
The trades of the replay book in booking order, with the strategy, entry, exit, costs and R of each. Read only.

The frozen-versus-learning comparison of two linked runs, computed on read from their stored equity (paired day bootstrap): learning_better, frozen_better, no_measurable_difference or too_little_history, with n and the probabilities. No answer (with the reason) while a run is not complete. Read only.

post.summary: Stop a queued or running replay after the session in flight; the finished sessions are kept and the run reads cancelled. 202 with the new state (cancelled or cancelling). 404 replay.not_found; 409 replay.not_active when it has finished.

put.summary: Choose the index the basket profile and ranking compare with (default Nifty 500): body {instrumentId} of a listed index of the instrument master. Session and CSRF token, no password (it loosens nothing). Answers the index {id, symbol, isDefault, name}. 422 reports.invalid for no id, an unknown id, a non-index or a retired index. Audited; the portfolio benchmark is not changed.

get.summary: The stored relative-strength rows, newest session first, at most 500: per share and pre-registered basket the volatility-adjusted momentum score and its percent rank (0 to 1) for the lookbacks 126 and 252 skipping the latest 21 sessions, with the number ranked, the state (value, insufficient, not_evaluable, unavailable, short_history, corporate_action_unresolved) and the membership basis (dated, or single_snapshot with survivorship). A rank is a number only for a value. Takes basket (an id or one of the names Nifty 50, Nifty 100, F&O stocks, Most liquid) and asOf (yyyy-MM-dd, the last closed session the row is as of). Read only; the rows are written once by the daily step, which is off until Market:RelativeStrength:Enabled. 400 market.relative_strength.invalid.

The P8 exit judged from what can be read: criteria 1 to 10 of P8-00, each MET, NOT MET or NOT EVALUABLE with its detail (a caveat beside a MET that rests on a convention); the answer the What-works view gives on the default set (a ranked cell with its n and lower bound, or the nothing-has-enough-evidence sentence with the counts); the cold and warm time of each report read; the honest limits. A criterion that could not be read is never MET. The interaction test, the owner's stopwatch note, the bundle size and the browser pass are files on the owner's machine and are read by scripts/p8-phase-check.sh, not here. Takes no parameter. Read only; the check runs the reports once more than a screen would and is not a polling target.
The autonomy settings in force (automatic approval and reserve promotion, both OFF = manual approval by default) with the history of changes. No order is placed in any setting

put.summary: Change the autonomy settings as the owner; appends an audited row. Needs a session, the CSRF token, the capability autonomy_form (off by default) and the password in the body, checked on EVERY change (an earlier step-up window does not count and is not used up); optional expectedSettingsId (the row the form was loaded at, 0 for none) makes a stale form a 409. 403 capabilities.off, 401 auth.invalid_credentials, 423 auth.locked, 403 autonomy.owner_only, 400 autonomy.values_invalid or autonomy.reason_invalid, 409 autonomy.stale, 429 auth.rate_limited

get.summary: The confirm tickets of a session (date, default today in India): state=open (default, the cards waiting for a tap) or all. Each has the exact text (show it verbatim), its hash, the client order id, the reference price, the notional, the worst case at the stop, the expiry and serverNow (the database clock: count down from it, not from the browser clock alone), whether the password is needed and why, the Soft codes not passed at issue and, once decided, the outcome. Read only

post.summary: The owner's tap on one ticket: textHash must be the hash of the stored text (409 execution.text_changed, nothing stored), before the expiry by the database clock (409 execution.ticket_expired), the account still semi_auto (execution.mode_changed), execution_enabled ON (execution.disabled), no halt or kill switch (execution.halted), ready (execution.not_ready), the day unlocked (execution.not_unlocked) and the last price within the drift limit (execution.price_moved, execution.price_unavailable; the ticket is then closed refused). The password is needed when the ticket says so (400 execution.password_required, 401 auth.invalid_credentials, 423 auth.locked; it counts toward the lockout); a reason when Soft checks did not pass (400 execution.reason_required). An optional Idempotency-Key header must equal the ticket id (400 execution.values_invalid). A repeat answers the saved decision with alreadyDecided true; after a skip, expiry or refusal 409 execution.ticket_closed. It writes one confirmed outcome and sends nothing

The owner declines one ticket: a decision (counted as declined), not an error. An optional plain-text reason of at most 200 characters. A session and the CSRF token, no password. 409 execution.ticket_closed when it was decided otherwise, execution.ticket_expired after its expiry

get.summary: The day unlocks of a session (date, default today in India): account, when it was unlocked and until when (15:30 India time). Read only

post.summary: The owner unlocks one account for today: a fresh password for this act (401 auth.invalid_credentials; an earlier step-up window does not count) and the actor from the session. Only on a trading day (409 execution.not_trading_day), only for an account in semi_auto or auto_live (409 execution.mode_not_executing) and before 15:30 India time (409 execution.unlock_closed). Locking the session does not remove it; a second unlock answers the first

get.summary: The limits sheet of one account (accountId): the row in force (null: no sheet, nothing is allowed), the raise waiting for its effectiveFrom, complete and the missing fields (an incomplete sheet allows nothing), the latest 20 rows, the compiled ceilings and serverNow (the database clock). Read only

put.summary: The owner's new limits sheet for one account, stored as a complete snapshot (an unset value allows nothing). A change that loosens anything against the row in force (a cap up, a wider window, a symbol or product added, exitAllOnLossHalt switched OFF; a mixed change counts as a raise) needs the password (400 execution.password_required, 401 auth.invalid_credentials, 423 auth.locked) and takes effect at 09:00 India time of the next trading day after one full closed session; a pure lowering needs only the session and the CSRF token and takes effect at once. 400 execution.values_invalid names the field (ceilings: 20 orders a day, 10 open positions, 50 symbols, window 09:16 to 15:00, products EQ_MIS only); 409 execution.disabled when the account's Trading role is off and the change is a raise; 409 execution.stale when the database refused the row. The answer is the sheet view with the row in force and the pending row

get.summary: The two global execution switches: the row in force (null: never written, both OFF), the raise waiting for its effectiveFrom, the latest 20 rows, autoLiveLocked (always true: no route turns auto_live_enabled on) and serverNow (the database clock). Read only

put.summary: The owner switches execution_enabled, with a reason of 1 to 300 characters and the password on EVERY change (400 execution.password_required, 401 auth.invalid_credentials, 423 auth.locked). Switching it ON while OFF is in force needs the gate Live:Writes:Enabled (checked BEFORE the password; 403 live.capability_off) and takes effect at 09:00 India time of the next trading day after one full closed session; OFF is in force at once and supersedes a waiting raise. autoLiveEnabled true is always 409 execution.auto_live_locked. 400 execution.values_invalid, 403 execution.owner_only, 409 execution.stale when the database refused the row. The values object is not changed here

get.summary: The kill-switch drills newest first (at most 50: passed, latency in ms, what was proved), the latest 20 drill requests with the execution service's answer (execution.drill_passed, execution.drill_failed, execution.drill_refused:<why>, execution.drill_unavailable outside the sandbox; null while unanswered), maxAgeDays (30: the ladder gate needs a drill no older) and serverNow. Optional accountId. Read only

post.summary: Run drill: leaves a drill command for the execution service (the answer is the command id; read the drills to see the result). Needs the session, the CSRF token and a fresh password (401 auth.invalid_credentials, 423 auth.locked). The service runs it only in the sandbox: it refuses when the account holds a position or a working order or any halt is active, raises a cancel halt of its own, proves that an entry is stopped at the send path before a transport that refuses everything, clears its halt and stores the row. No order is sent in any case. 409 execution.drill_refused while a halt is in force, 404 execution.account_unknown, 400 execution.values_invalid

get.summary: The execution service: down / recovering / ready / halted from its heartbeat (down when older than 30 s), its process environment (none, sandbox, live), each account's mode and gate (closed until the mode ladder exists), halts and the open intents. Read only; an empty database answers environment none and closed gates

The P12 phase check (read only): per Trading account, 30 consecutive counted semi-auto sessions with zero reconciliation breaks, judged from stored records up to through (default: the newest session whose final reconciliation is due) as MET, NOT MET or NOT EVALUABLE with the per-session lines, the facts beside the verdict, the boundary fact and the honest limits. The phase exit is MET when at least one account is MET; an unavailable or missing fact never counts as clean. Optional accountId. 422 execution.invalid on a later date or an unknown account. Nothing is written; no token, client id, secret or balance

Today at a glance, per account (optional date, default the current session in India): effective mode and since when, the meters (orders, notional, worst-case loss, open positions) against the limits sheet in force with the pending raise beside it, open tickets, halts, alarms and positions without confirmed protection, the canary switch and the evidence line. A figure is value, insufficient, unavailable, not_evaluable or empty and an unreadable input is unavailable with its reason, never 0. Read only; no token, client id, secret or balance

The orders of a day, newest first, 50 a page (date, accountId, stateGroup pending|working|live|done|stopped, page from 1): state in P12-01's words (an unknown word is passed through with stateKnown false), who caused it (tap, auto, system, owner), broker ids as received, per-fill slippage in ticks and percent against the ticket price (positive is worse), rejection codes and the broker code. 422 execution.invalid on an unknown filter. Read only

The open positions (optional accountId): net quantity, average, last price and unrealised result (unavailable when the price is older than the feed limit), risk to the stop, protection confirmed|missing|unknown (confirmed only from a recent clean read of the broker's order book), source ours|foreign and reconciliation matched|break|not_run|unavailable. Read only

The action log with the alarms, halts, drills, mode and settings changes, newest first, 50 a page (date, kind, by auto|tap|system|owner, page from 1). 422 execution.invalid on an unknown filter. Read only: the log is insert-only

The execution items for the bell, derived on every read from insert-only rows: exec_confirm_waiting, exec_auto_action, exec_order_rejected, exec_protection_missing, exec_halted, exec_kill_switch, exec_demoted, exec_recon_break, exec_not_ready, exec_ip_invalid, exec_cap_near, exec_day_summary. Each id includes its cause; a resolved item stays 24 hours and is not counted. Read only

The alarms of the execution service's protection logic, newest first (at most 200): protection pending or breached, flatten started or incomplete, oversold and the rest. open=true keeps only those not cleared. Read only; an alarm is cleared by the engine or the owner, never deleted

The halts of the execution service (the kill switch), newest first (at most 200): scope, account, level (entries, cancel, exit_all, freeze), the trigger code, who started it and, once it ended, how (owner release or automatic clear). active=true keeps only those in force. Read only

post.summary: The owner's button: leaves a halt command for the execution service, which records the halt (the answer is the command id; read the halts to see it). Needs a session and the CSRF token and NO password: starting a halt is the safe direction. exit_all additionally needs the step-up window (403 auth.step_up_required) because it realises losses. 400 execution.halt_invalid

Releases a halt as the owner: only the owner can, with the gate Live:Writes:Enabled on (checked BEFORE the password; 403 live.capability_off), a fresh password for this act (401 auth.invalid_credentials; an earlier step-up window does not count), the actor from the session and a reason. Refused with 409 execution.release_refused and every reason when the halt already ended, the reason is missing or too short (a drawdown halt needs 20 characters), an exit_all halt still has an open position, a protection halt still has an open protection alarm, or the halt is a freeze (released only when it came from a reconciliation break and every break of its account has a resolution). 404 execution.halt_unknown

get.summary: The reconciliation runs and breaks of the execution service (at most 200 of each, newest first): per run the kind (continuous, eod, final, recovery), whether the broker could be read and how many breaks; per break the kind (position_mismatch, trade_missing, trade_extra, order_mismatch, fill_mismatch, unknown_xd_order, foreign_conflict, unavailable), the account, the figures' summary and the owner's resolution if any. Optional date (the session) and accountId. Read only; a break is never corrected automatically

post.summary: Resolves a reconciliation break as the owner: only the owner can, with the gate Live:Writes:Enabled on (checked BEFORE the password; 403 live.capability_off), a fresh password for this act (401 auth.invalid_credentials; an earlier step-up window does not count) and the actor from the session. resolution is accept_broker (the engine then appends an adoption event; nothing is rewritten) or dismiss_foreign (a foreign conflict only); note is at most 300 characters. 400 execution.resolution_invalid, 404 execution.break_unknown, 409 execution.break_resolved. The freeze it caused can be released once every break of the account is resolved

get.summary: Whether execution can act today, per account (optional date, default the current session in India): state ready, not_ready or unavailable (also when nothing was ever recorded; only ready lets anything act), the six checks with pass, fail or unavailable and their ages, when the token ends, since when the account has been ready, the first day the IP can be changed at Dhan, the owner's newest IP attestation, P11-05's newest SEBI re-check, the last 20 states recorded at 09:10:30 India time and the highest sends per second. Read only; no token, client id, key or secret

post.summary: Check now: leaves a readiness_now command row; the execution service probes within a second and the new record shows in GET /readiness. A session and the CSRF token, no password. It reads two things at the broker (profile and configured IP) and sends nothing

The owner records that Dhan's web tool (IP Setup, Get Static IP) showed orders allowed (or not) for an IP: accountId, ip (one IPv4 or IPv6 address), ordersAllowed and a plain-text note of at most 200 characters. A session and the CSRF token, the actor from the session, the time from the database. It is a claim and never contacts the broker; ordersAllowed false is recorded and keeps the attestation check failing. 400 execution.values_invalid, 404 execution.not_found

get.summary: The execution mode of each account with a Trading role (paper, manual_live, assisted): configured and effective, a change waiting for the next open, the open promotion request, the evidence for the next step (every check with pass, fail or unavailable; unavailable never passes) and the latest 20 trail rows. Read only; no token, secret, client id or balance

post.summary: The owner asks for the next mode (one step up): only the owner, with Live:Writes:Enabled on (checked BEFORE the password; 403 live.capability_off), a fresh password and a reason. Stores the evidence and its hash and a window (confirmable from the close of the second trading session, until the close of the fifth) and grants nothing. 409 execution.mode_not_adjacent, execution.mode_gate_failed with every reason (unavailable never passes). Only assisted exists; semi_auto and auto_live are 400 execution.values_invalid

The owner confirms the request inside its window, with the live-writes gate before a fresh password. The gate is evaluated again. 409 execution.cooling_off, execution.request_expired, execution.mode_gate_failed, execution.stale. Writes one trail row that takes effect at 09:00 India time of the next trading day

The owner lowers the mode at once: a session and the CSRF token and NO password and no live-writes gate, because it lowers risk. 409 execution.mode_not_lower unless the target is below the effective mode

get.summary: The owner's depth-recorder switch (OFF = never set), its history and why the recorder is not running now (deployment flag, switch, service, token, plan, disk). No depth data

put.summary: Switch the depth recorder ON or OFF as the owner; appends an audited row. Needs a session, the CSRF token and the password in the body, checked on EVERY change (an earlier step-up window does not count and is not used up). It only allows the recorder: the deployment flag Depth__Enabled and the service depth-recorder must be on too. 401 auth.invalid_credentials, 423 auth.locked, 403 depth.owner_only, 400 depth.reason_invalid, 429 auth.rate_limited

get.summary: The owner's option-chain recorder switch (OFF = never set), its history and why the recorder is not running now (deployment flag, switch, service, token, plan, disk). No chain data

put.summary: Switch the option-chain recorder ON or OFF as the owner; appends an audited row. Needs a session, the CSRF token and the password in the body, checked on EVERY change (an earlier step-up window does not count and is not used up). It only allows the recorder: the deployment flag Options__Chain__Enabled and the service option-chain-recorder must be on too. 401 auth.invalid_credentials, 423 auth.locked, 403 options.owner_only, 400 options.reason_invalid, 429 auth.rate_limited

get.summary: The owner's expired-options backfill switch (OFF = never set), whether the probe result was accepted, its history, the progress (keys done, empty, given up, left, estimated hours) and why the backfill is not running now. No bars

put.summary: Switch the expired-options backfill ON or OFF as the owner; appends an audited row. Needs a session, the CSRF token and the password in the body, checked on EVERY change (an earlier step-up window does not count and is not used up). It only allows the backfill: the deployment flag Options__Backfill__Enabled, the probe acceptance and the service options-backfill must be on too. 401 auth.invalid_credentials, 423 auth.locked, 403 options.owner_only, 400 options.reason_invalid, 429 auth.rate_limited

Record, as the owner, that the probe result of the backfill was read and accepted (ADR 0177); the backfill refuses to run until this exists. Appends an audited row. Needs a session, the CSRF token and the password in the body, checked on every call. 401 auth.invalid_credentials, 423 auth.locked, 403 options.owner_only, 400 options.reason_invalid, 429 auth.rate_limited

get.summary: The quality verdicts of one underlying's option archive between from and to (default: the last 30 days; at most 400): per session and check the status (pass|warn|fail|unavailable), value, threshold and reason, whether the session is usable, and the cumulative usable chain sessions up to to. 400 options.invalid_query for an unknown underlying or a bad range; an empty list when nothing is recorded. No price, IV or Greek

The option archive per underlying: recorded and usable chain sessions, first and last recorded date, the gaps by outcome, the backfill keys done, empty and given up, and the half-spread model state. A figure with no source is state unavailable with its reason (not_recorded, no_model), never a number. An empty list when nothing is stored. No price, IV or Greek

The newest stored expression runs (limit 1 to 100, default 20; profile = the 64-character lower-case hex hash): per run the profile, the counts paired and unpaired by reason, and the shares of the paired trades on a model price, a derived expiry, the recent-archive spread and each lot-feasibility word. 400 options.invalid_query for a bad limit or profile; state unavailable with no_runs and an empty list when none is stored. No price, IV or return figure
One stored expression run by its 64-character id; 404 research.not_found for an unknown id

The stored pair formations whose window overlaps from to to (default the last 400 days; at most 400), oldest quarter first: candidates, tested, unavailable, selected, the Benjamini-Hochberg threshold and the half-life distribution in sessions. 400 options.invalid_query for an inverted or over-long range; state unavailable with no_runs and an empty list when none is stored

Counts of the stored filings between from and to (default: the last 365 days; at most 800) per kind and quarter: stored with a broadcast time, stored without one (by reason), superseded, out of order, and the tracked instruments with none. A kind with nothing stored answers unavailable. Counts only; 400 filings.invalid_query for a bad range

Counts of the stored LLM announcement extractions (P15-08) per month of the announcement, model file hash, prompt version, schema version and state (ok, invalid_output, model_unavailable, too_long), with the number of order values dropped as ungrounded. Counts only: no announcement text, no reason, no answer. Nothing on a decision path reads these rows

Filing envelope metadata, newest broadcast first, at most 200 rows (no file content, no path). With asOf (an instant with an offset, needs instrument and kind) it is the point-in-time answer: the filings the market knew at that instant. 400 filings.invalid_query for an unknown kind or instrument or an asOf without an offset
The metadata of one stored filing; 404 filings.not_found for an unknown id

The parse outcome of one stored results filing with the parser version, the stored facts (field, span, basis, state, number as filed or reason, unit) and the counts and sanity flags the parser kept. Outcome not_parsed until the parse step has run. No file content, no path; 404 filings.not_found for an unknown id

The stored evaluations of one family (filter:results, ext:ev-1, ext:fu-1, ext:llm-1, ext:iv-1, pead, pairs:intraday-1 or expr:option_buy), newest first, at most 100: the verdict (KEEP, DROP, INCONCLUSIVE or NOT_EVALUABLE) with the named missing quantities, the counts, the limits and the estimates, evidence and inputs as JSON. A value that is not available is the text unavailable, never a number. 400 extensions.invalid_query for an unknown family
One stored evaluation by its 64-character id, with its evidence block; 404 extensions.not_found for an unknown id

post.summary: Hide one loosened limit (noticeId sizing:{id}, budget:{id} or basket:{id}) on every plan read from now on. Session and CSRF token, no password; insert-only, the owner is the session; repeating it changes nothing (204). The change itself is never edited. 422 plans.invalid (a malformed id or a change that did not loosen), 404 plans.not_found, 401

get.summary: The automatic dismissal setting plans.loosening_banner.auto_dismiss (OFF by default; no row means OFF) with the version and the latest 50 changes. When ON, a loosening a published plan already showed is hidden at the build of the next plan, recorded as automatic. Read only

put.summary: The owner switches the automatic dismissal ON or OFF (autoDismiss, expectedVersion = the version read). The password is needed on EVERY change, ON and OFF alike (403 auth.step_up_required without one, 401 auth.invalid_credentials, 423 auth.locked); a row is appended with the owner as actor. 409 plans.stale when the setting changed meanwhile

get.summary: The basket settings in force (the gate's breadth source, tracked by default or basket:<id>; the cap on open risk per correlation cluster, percent of capital, off by default; the cluster cut, 0.70) with the version, the newest loosening change and the latest 50 changes (key, old and new value, direction tighten, loosen or neutral, actor, time, hash). Read only

put.summary: The owner changes the basket settings (breadthSource tracked or basket:<id>, maxClusterRiskPct above 0 up to 100 or clearCap true to turn the cap off, clusterRho 0.1 to 1.0); a value left out stays. The password is needed on EVERY change (401 auth.invalid_credentials, 423 auth.locked); each key that changes is appended as a row with its direction. 400 selection.invalid, 403 selection.owner_only, 404 selection.basket_not_found, 409 selection.stale

get.summary: The stored daily context of one basket (basket, optional from and to as yyyy-MM-dd; the newest 400 rows, newest first): members, voters, the 20, 50 and 200 day breadth, advance and new-high shares, dispersion, average correlation, state and membership basis (point_in_time or single_snapshot). Descriptive only; read only

The universe settings in force (the fewest trades of a tier cell to be read in place of its parent, 30; the fewest trades of a tier to be an observation, 100; the registered basket names a strategy x basket comparison may use) and the latest 50 changes. Read only

put.summary: The owner changes the universe settings (minTradesChild 1 to 1000, linkMinTrades 10 to 10000, registeredBaskets: comma separated names, 1 to 20; autoPropose: true or false, default false, when true the cells command proposes each tier observation as a hypothesis by the actor auto and applies nothing); a value left out stays. The password is needed on EVERY change (401 auth.invalid_credentials, 423 auth.locked); each key that changes is appended as a row. expectedVersion (the version of the read) is required. 400 learning.invalid, 403 learning.owner_only, 409 learning.stale

get.summary: The sizing settings in force (volatility targeting and the capacity cap, both OFF by default, the volatility floor 0.5, the capacity share 0.005, the budget minimum fit 0.5) with the version, the newest loosening change and the latest 50 changes (key, old and new value, direction tighten or loosen, actor, time, hash). Sizing only scales a suggestion down. Read only

put.summary: The owner changes the sizing settings (volTargetEnabled, floor 0.25 to 1.0, capacityEnabled, capacityPct above 0 and at most 0.005, the one capacity share of the app: it can only be tightened, minFit 0.25 to 1.0, the lowest share of its size a basket budget may cut a candidate to); a value left out stays. The password is needed on EVERY change (401 auth.invalid_credentials, 423 auth.locked); each key that changes is appended as a row with its direction. 400 selection.invalid, 403 selection.owner_only, 409 selection.stale

get.summary: The basket risk budgets in force (a basket's share, 1 to 100 percent, of the day's total open risk limit; a basket with no row has no budget) and the latest 50 changes. Read only

put.summary: The owner sets one basket's risk budget (budgetPct 1 to 100, or null to remove it) with the password on EVERY change. Raising or removing a budget is recorded as loosen. 400 selection.invalid, 403 selection.owner_only, 404 selection.basket_not_found, 409 selection.stale

get.summary: What the stored closed trades of one run (run, the 64-character key) would have done with the down-only volatility scale, on the same trades: cumulative net R, maximum drawdown and total with and without it, the two halves (a half below 30 trades is insufficient), the trades with no scale. Optional from and to (entry dates) and floor (0.25, 0.5 or 0.75 as a labelled sensitivity; left out it is the stored floor). Descriptive, before costs, recommends nothing, writes nothing, never scales above 1. 422 reports.invalid or reports.too_large

The event-risk filter switch: whether it is on (the newest decision row; no row, or an unreadable history, is off), its window in sessions (resultsWithinDays, 2 by default), the approval setting (manual by default, or auto), who decided (owner or auto), the latest 50 decision rows, the reasons the filter is not acting (switch_off, no_calendar_rows, no_entry_for_instruments with a count, history_unreadable, calendar_unreadable), the calendar coverage and the newest protocol-F verdict state (unavailable until it exists). Read only

put.summary: The owner switches the event-risk filter or changes its window or approval, with a reason of 1 to 300 characters and the password on EVERY change (401 auth.invalid_credentials, 423 auth.locked). enabled is required; resultsWithinDays (0 to 10) and approval (manual or auto) left out keep the value in force. 400 selection.reason_invalid, 400 selection.invalid_setting, 403 selection.owner_only, 409 selection.stale when the database refused the row. Setting approval to auto is itself an owner act; the automatic path may turn the filter on only from a stored KEEP verdict and is recorded as auto, never as an owner decision

get.summary: The results meetings known at asOf (default now; an instant with an offset) whose event session (the first trading day on or after the meeting date) lies between from and to (default: today in India and the next 59 days; at most 120 days): symbol, period end, meeting date, event session, trading days from the India date of asOf, when the exchange published the row, revision (1, then 2 and up for reschedules), plus the count and the first 300 symbols of the tracked instruments without an entry. A meeting published after asOf is not shown. An empty list is not an error; 400 calendar.invalid_query for a bad range, an asOf without an offset or an unknown parameter
The owner's opening-minute recorder switch (OFF = never set), its history and why the recorder is not running now (deployment flag, switch, service). No bar data

put.summary: Switch the opening-minute recorder ON or OFF as the owner; appends an audited row. Needs a session, the CSRF token and the password in the body, checked on EVERY change. It only allows the recorder: the deployment flag OpeningBars__Enabled and the service opening-bars must be on too. 401 auth.invalid_credentials, 423 auth.locked, 403 opening_bars.owner_only, 400 opening_bars.reason_invalid, 429 auth.rate_limited

get.summary: The owner's trade-tick recorder switch (OFF = never set), its history and why the recorder is not running now (deployment flag, switch, service, token, plan, disk). No tick data

put.summary: Switch the trade-tick recorder ON or OFF as the owner; appends an audited row. Needs a session, the CSRF token and the password in the body, checked on EVERY change (an earlier step-up window does not count and is not used up). It only allows the recorder: the deployment flag Ticks__Enabled and the service tick-recorder must be on too. 401 auth.invalid_credentials, 423 auth.locked, 403 ticks.owner_only, 400 ticks.reason_invalid, 429 auth.rate_limited

get.summary: The compliance records, newest first (kind filters; limit 1 to 200, default 50), with the newest record of each kind (null = nothing recorded for that kind, which is empty and not 'no change') and whether the web may write now. The overdue flag is set on the newest record of a kind whose review date has passed. 422 live.invalid

post.summary: Write one compliance record as the owner; insert-only and audited (kind, outcome, decided date; never the text). Needs a session, the CSRF token, the deployment gate Live:Writes:Enabled (off by default) and the password in the body, checked on EVERY save (an earlier step-up window does not count and is not used up). The record is your note of what you were told: nothing is checked at Dhan or the ISP. 403 live.capability_off, 401 auth.invalid_credentials, 423 auth.locked, 403 live.owner_only, 422 live.invalid (a field that looks like an IP address, client id or token, or a rule of the record), 429 auth.rate_limited

get.summary: The ramp of a live account: step (null = none, so no live allocation), the scale and the live risk it gives, hold, the evidence gates G1 to G7 (state, number, threshold, n; only pass counts), the breach rules, today's loss, the halts and the history. 404 live.account_not_found

post.summary: Set the ramp step as the owner: S1 first, or lower. Insert-only and audited. Needs a session, the CSRF token, the deployment gate Live:Writes:Enabled (off by default) and the password in the body, checked on EVERY move. A raise is 409 live.gates_not_met until the evidence gates exist; 409 live.step_not_adjacent, 409 live.stale, 403 live.capability_off, 401 auth.invalid_credentials, 423 auth.locked, 422 live.invalid, 429 auth.rate_limited. Nothing here places an order

Clear a hold of the ramp as the owner. Refused with 409 live.hold_condition_active while a breach condition still holds on the evidence read now (event breaches need the cooldown sessions without a new one). Insert-only and audited. Same gates as the step: session, CSRF, Live:Writes:Enabled and the password in the body, checked on this call.

Record as the owner that the small-live exit report was read and is met, the key to S3. Refused with 409 live.exit_not_checked unless that report says MET right now; the report is the small-live phase check (GET /phase-check, P11-06), read now, and anything it cannot read or judge is not a MET. Same gates as the step.

get.summary: The halts of the live accounts (daily and weekly loss limits reached), newest first: the period, the limit, what was measured under which state (value, realised_only, unavailable) and what the halt does. A halt is advice: you place every order. accountId optional; from and to default to the last 30 days, at most 92.
The derived notices of the live record: a halt in force, a hold, a capture gap, a step the evidence has earned, a compliance re-check overdue. Words and a route only; nothing to run.

The capture of one session of a manual-live account (date defaults to today, never the future): health (healthy, gap, not_run), the runs, one row per approved ticket (figures captured so far; the outcome once the settle has written it, null before), the fills no ticket owns and the owner's own trades, and the evidence. Every order-dependent field is 'unavailable' when the session has no order evidence, never a number. Read only. 404 live.not_found, 422 live.invalid

The stored outcomes of live tickets (filled, partial, over_allocation, not_triggered, missed_no_order, missed_unfilled, rejected, missed_unknown, unknown), newest session first. accountId optional; from and to default to the last 30 days (range at most 92 days); page from 1, size 1 to 200. Read only. 422 live.invalid

The live entries measured against what the plan promised, newest session first: bucket, reference kind, fill VWAP and quantity, and the slippage in rupees, ticks, basis points and R split into the delay before the order and the execution itself (positive is worse for you; a figure with no input is 'unavailable', never 0). accountId optional; from and to default to the last 30 days (range at most 92 days); page from 1, size 1 to 200. Read only. 422 live.invalid

The stored slippage estimates of a week (a Monday; default the newest stored): one row per liquidity bucket, side, style and reference kind with its n; a row under the minimum n is 'insufficient' and has no mean. 'empty' when nothing is stored. Nothing is applied from them. Read only. 422 live.invalid

The stored capacity scores of a week: the share of entry orders filled in full for the account and for each liquidity bucket, with a credible interval, 'insufficient' below the minimum counted orders. Display only. Read only. 422 live.invalid

The waterfall of one round trip by the id of its execution: plan result, entry slippage, exit difference, actual gross, and charges and actual net only when every fill's charges are recorded. 'unavailable' with the reason when the position did not close in the session or the plan was not graded. Read only. 404 live.not_found

The same tickets on the live account and one paper account: the shortfall in R on the plan's risk per share (positive is live worse) with its n, mean, 95 % interval and the non-inferiority verdict (within, not_within, inconclusive, or insufficient under the minimum pairs), the tickets that could not be paired with their reason, the live slippage histogram of one reference kind and the cumulative R over the paired set. basis gross (default) or net; net only when both sides have charges for every pair, else gross is returned and says so. Computed on read; read only. 404 live.not_found, 422 live.invalid, 422 live.paper_account_required

The small-live phase check recomputed from the stored records: MET, NOT MET or NOT EVALUABLE for criteria C1 to C8 and the integrity line, the week lines, what is printed and not judged, the blockers (with whose act) and the limits. Read only; it never moves a ramp step (exit_confirmed is the owner's act). accountId defaults to the one live account, through to the last closed session; 404 live.not_found without a live account, 422 live.invalid for a date after the last closed session or before the first live session.

Plan R to actual R by strategy or month: plan R, missed triggers, missed (cause unknown), entry slippage, exit difference, charges, result, with the tickets left out listed. A figure with no input is 'unavailable', not 0. Computed on read; read only. 404 live.not_found, 422 live.invalid
The live switches (live.auto_approve_tickets, live.auto_ramp_up), both OFF when nothing is stored, with their history. No setting lets this system place an order

put.summary: Change the live switches as the owner; appends an audited row (the database stamps the hash). Same gates as the ramp step: session, CSRF, Live:Writes:Enabled and the password on every change. 409 live.stale, 403 live.capability_off, 401 auth.invalid_credentials, 423 auth.locked, 422 live.invalid, 429 auth.rate_limited

get.summary: What stands about the owner's confirmation of the charge sheet (not_confirmed, confirmed, stale, sheet_missing, revoked), whether confirming is switched on (off by default), a preview of the stored sheet (the one named by sheetId, else the one in force) with the rates hash a confirmation must carry, and the history. 400 chargesheet.sheet_invalid

post.summary: Confirm ONE stored charge sheet as the owner, at the SHA-256 of its rates as shown; appends an audited row. Needs a session, the CSRF token and the password in the body, checked on EVERY request. 401 auth.invalid_credentials, 423 auth.locked, 403 chargesheet.capability_off or chargesheet.owner_only, 404 chargesheet.sheet_not_found, 400 chargesheet.sheet_invalid, chargesheet.rates_invalid or chargesheet.reason_invalid, 409 chargesheet.rates_changed, 429 auth.rate_limited. Repeating the same confirmation writes nothing and answers changed=false

Withdraw the confirmation in force as the owner; appends an audited row (a revoke never edits the confirmation it withdraws). Works also while confirming is switched off. Revoking when nothing is confirmed writes nothing and answers changed=false. Needs a session, the CSRF token and the password in the body, checked on EVERY request. 401 auth.invalid_credentials, 423 auth.locked, 400 chargesheet.reason_invalid, 429 auth.rate_limited

put.summary: Switch on or off the capability to confirm a charge sheet (off by default; no setting confirms anything by itself). Appends an audited row. Needs a session, the CSRF token and the password in the body, checked on EVERY request. 401 auth.invalid_credentials, 423 auth.locked, 400 chargesheet.reason_invalid, 429 auth.rate_limited

get.summary: The owner-act capabilities (experiments_ui, learning_moves_ui, autonomy_form, exports, pwa), each OFF until the owner switches it on, with what it allows, when it was last switched and the latest switches. Read only

put.summary: Switch one capability ON or OFF as the owner; appends an audited row (the same state again writes nothing and answers changed=false). Switching ON needs a session, the CSRF token and the password in the body, checked on EVERY request; switching OFF needs no password. 401 auth.invalid_credentials, 423 auth.locked, 404 capabilities.not_found, 422 capabilities.invalid, 429 auth.rate_limited (switching ON only)

get.summary: The assistant's proposals, newest first (limit 1 to 100, default 50), optionally of one state (pending, accepted, rejected, expired) and kind (hypothesis, basket_add, basket_remove). A pending proposal past its expiry is shown as expired. Read only. 422 assistant.invalid
One proposal with its evidence, the engine's checks and its decision. Read only. 404 assistant.proposal_not_found

post.summary: The owner's accept: runs every engine check again, then writes a proposed hypothesis or changes a basket (never tracks an instrument, starts a backfill, approves or runs anything, or places an order). Needs a fresh password in the body and the switch allow_proposal_accept. A second accept returns the first result. 409 assistant.capability_off, assistant.proposal_closed, assistant.proposal_stale, hypotheses.open_limit

The owner rejects a proposal (no password: the safe direction); the same idea is not proposed again for 30 days. A second reject returns the first result. 409 assistant.proposal_closed; 422 assistant.invalid

get.summary: The eval runs, newest first (limit 1 to 50, default 20), each with its summary: per set the outcome, the rates with their 95 % intervals and the verdict. Read only. 422 assistant.invalid

Whether the accepted eval run still describes the assistant: the baseline, the current fingerprint, stale and what differs (model, runtime, prompt X, sets, thresholds). No network call. With no accepted run: 'no accepted eval run'. Read only
One eval run with its cases, the prompts and the parameters it measured. Read only. 404 assistant.eval_not_found

post.summary: The owner types a trading idea (10 to 2,000 characters); starts the model job and answers 202 with the draft in state drafting (poll GET). Stores nothing as a strategy and runs nothing. 409 assistant.disabled, assistant.limit, assistant.busy; 422 assistant.invalid

get.summary: The newest finished drafts (limit 1 to 50, default 20) with their decisions. Read only. 422 assistant.invalid
