nextStates.description: The states it may move to.

history.description: Every step, oldest first; empty in a list.

note.description: What a lesson does and does not do.

LessonView.description: A lesson as the API shows it (P6-16, ADR 0078): the newest row of its log, with the legal next states and, for one lesson, its history.

LimitsCeilingsView.description: The compiled ceilings the owner cannot exceed (code constants, not settings). Money caps have none; the order rate is P12-01's `exec.max_orders_per_second`.

LimitsChangeBody.description: The owner's limits sheet. A missing value is unset and allows nothing. Times are India time HH:mm. The password is needed only for a raise. The actor is never taken from the body.

LimitsRowView.description: One stored limits snapshot as the owner sees it (spec P12-09 Contract). A null cap is unset: it allows nothing. Times are India time `HH:mm`.

LimitsView.description:
The limits of one account: the row in force (null: no sheet, nothing is allowed), the raise waiting for its `effectiveFrom`, whether the sheet in force is complete and which fields are missing (an incomplete sheet allows nothing),
the latest 20 rows and the ceilings.

fixId.description: The id of the fix, 1 or more.

password.description: The owner's password, typed again for THIS act.

LinkLessonRequest.description: The body of a lesson link: the fix to link is a hypothesis or an experiment.

LiveCapacityRowView.description: One capacity row: the share of orders filled in full for a scope (the account, or a bucket) with the counts by class.

LiveCapacityView.description: The capacity snapshot of one week.

LiveCaptureEvidenceView.description: What the capture rests on, with its stated limits.

LiveCaptureFillView.description: A fill no ticket owns (unmatched, with the reason) or the owner's own trade.

LiveCaptureRunView.description: One run of a poll or the settle.

LiveCaptureTicketView.description:
One approved ticket. string? LiveCaptureTicketView.Outcome is null while the settle has not written it (the figures beside it are what is captured so far); long? LiveCaptureTicketView.OrderedQty and string LiveCaptureTicketView.Protection are the words `unavailable` / null when there is no order
evidence; double? LiveCaptureTicketView.MissedR only for the two missed outcomes; string? LiveCaptureTicketView.RejectText is the broker's own text, data to be shown as text.

LiveCaptureView.description: The capture of one session: its health, the runs, one row per approved ticket, the fills no ticket owns and the owner's own trades, and what the evidence is.

LiveCriterion.description: One criterion with its call, the numbers behind it and the caveat a MET rests on (null when none).

LiveEquityLineView.description: One cumulative-R line over the paired set; `unavailable` (no points) when an input is missing for any pair.

LiveEquityPointView.description: A point of a cumulative line: the day, the cumulative R and how many pairs are in it.

LiveEquityView.description: The three lines over the paired set only, in session order: on plan prices, paper, live.

LiveExcludedView.description: A ticket that could not be paired, with exactly one reason and what is known about the other side.

LiveExecutionEvidenceView.description: What stands behind a figure of the execution feedback: the basis, how many entries, over which sessions, against which references, with which bucket edges, and the stated limits. No figure is given without its n.

LiveExecutionView.description:
One live entry against its reference. Positive slippage is worse for the owner. Every figure is a state and a number only for a value (no reference, no order evidence or no stop gives `unavailable`, never 0); delay plus execution equals the total.
bool LiveExecutionView.WaterfallAvailable says whether the round trip closed in the session with a graded plan, so the waterfall can be read.

LiveExecutionsPage.description: A page of executions with the evidence.

LiveFeedStatus.description:
The state of the live feed as the screen needs it: hub event `feedStatus` (pushed on connect, on a change of `state` or `subscribed`, and every 15 seconds) and the body of `GET /api/live/status` (the fallback when the hub is not connected).
`state` is the feed's own word: `connected` (streaming), `idle` (connected, nothing to follow), `connecting`, `reconnecting`, `closed` (outside its window), `paused` (the owner paused the service), `no_token`, `token_refused`,
`flapping`; or `not_running` when the feed reports nothing (never started, stopped, crashed: no heartbeat in the last 60 seconds). `subscribed` is the number of instruments the feed follows (0 unless it reports); `lastTickAt` the exchange
time of its latest tick of any instrument (UTC), null when none yet.

LiveGapExcludedView.description: A ticket left out of the gap with the reason.

LiveGapGroupView.description: One group of the execution gap with its rows (plan R, missed, missed unknown, entry, exit, charges, result, overrides), the per-ticket mean of the result and the tickets left out.

LiveGapRowView.description: One row of a gap group: a label and a figure that is a value only when its input exists.

LiveHaltView.description: A halt as the screen reads it: the period, the limit, what was measured under which state, and what it does (it is advice: the owner places every order).

LiveHistogramBinView.description: One bin of the slippage histogram in basis points; a null edge is open.

LiveHistogramView.description: The histogram of live total entry slippage of one reference kind. string LiveHistogramView.State is `value`, `insufficient` (under 10 observations, no bins) or `empty`.

LiveLossView.description: The loss of the last measured session: the state (value, realised_only, unavailable), the figures and what is left out.

LiveNoticeView.description: A notice of the live record, derived on read: the words, the route and nothing to run.

LivePairView.description: One pair of the same ticket: the live and the paper R and the shortfall split into entry and exit.

LivePhaseCheckView.description: The report and its deterministic text. string LivePhaseCheckView.State is `value`, or `empty` when there is no live session yet.

LivePhaseReport.description: The phase check: the call, the criteria, the weeks, what is printed, what blocks and the limits. Recomputed on every read; nothing is stored.

LivePrintedLine.description: A label and a value as printed; a value that does not exist reads as words, never a digit.

LiveReportEvidenceView.description: What stands behind every figure of the report: the basis, how many, which sessions, which reference kind, which paper account and epoch, the pair rule, the exclusion counts and the stated limits. No figure is shown without it.

LiveScope.description:
What a Portfolio screen asks the hub to follow (argument of `Subscribe`, ADR 0024 §7): the prices of the instruments of these holdings are pushed, nothing else.
`accountId` and `bucketId` are the screen's scope, with the meaning they have for `GET /api/holdings/summary`: without `accountId` every open holding of the accounts that count in totals, with it every open holding of that account
(any account that is not archived); `bucketId` narrows either to one bucket. This is the set the tiles and the group rows are made of.
`holdingIds` are the holdings the screen shows (rows of the grid, the open drawer); they are added to the scope's holdings even when the scope would not include them (an account that does not count in totals, a filter applied on the screen only).
At most 1000 are read; holdings that are closed or have no instrument are ignored. Leave `accountId`, `bucketId` and `holdingIds` null or empty for all accounts that count in totals.
The server turns holdings into instruments; the messages carry instrument ids (as `instrumentId` of the holdings list). A second `Subscribe` replaces the first.

autoApproveTickets.description: `live.auto_approve_tickets`: a ticket with a live allocation may be approved by rule (also needs `autonomy.auto_approve_tickets`).

autoRampUp.description: `live.auto_ramp_up`: the evaluator may raise S1 to S2 by rule (P11-04b; no effect before).

writesEnabled.description: Whether the web may write now.

notice.description: No setting lets this system place an order.

LiveSettingsView.description: The live switches in force. `id` is null while nothing is stored (both OFF).

LiveSetupItem.description: A service or switch of the setup and whether it is on; Blocks is true when the phase cannot be evidenced while it is off (the auto switches do not block: they default OFF by design).

LiveSlippageRowView.description: One slippage row: a bucket, side, style and reference kind with its n; the mean and median (in basis points) with their intervals are states, a number only for a value. string? LiveSlippageRowView.Proposal is a sentence nothing reads automatically.

LiveSlippageView.description: The slippage snapshot of one week. string LiveSlippageView.State is `empty` when nothing is stored for the week.

LiveVsPaperSummaryView.description: The statistics of the paired shortfalls (R on the plan's risk per share; positive is live worse). Every figure is a state and a number only for a value; under the minimum pairs it is `insufficient` and says so.

LiveVsPaperView.description: The report: string LiveVsPaperView.State is `value`, `empty` (no live round trip yet) or `unavailable` (the paper record could not be read).

LiveWaterfallRowView.description: One line of the waterfall: string LiveWaterfallRowView.Op is start, minus or total; MetricView LiveWaterfallRowView.R is unavailable when the plan has no stop (the rupees are then the result).

LiveWaterfallView.description:
The waterfall of one round trip (plan result, entry slippage, exit difference, actual gross, charges, actual net). string LiveWaterfallView.State is `value` or `unavailable` (the position did not close in the session, or the plan was not graded); then there are no rows
and IReadOnlyList<string> LiveWaterfallView.Notes says why.

LiveWeekLine.description: One ISO week of the window.

model.description: The alias the server serves (for example xd-main), when it answered.

modelFile.description: Base name of the loaded model file, when the server said.

modelSha256.description: SHA-256 of that file when it is one of the pinned files; null for an unknown file.

build.description: The server's build number text, when it said.

checkedAt.description: When the answer was taken (cached for a few seconds).

startCommand.description: How the owner starts the server.

LlmStatusView.description: What `GET /api/assistant/llm-status` answers. No key, no path and no address of the server is ever in it.

LongTermLot.description: A profitable open lot that turns 12 months old soon (the `long_term_soon` rule): `LongTermOn` is the date it is 12 months old, `DaysLeft` the days until then, `GainPct` its unrealised gain in percent (null for a lot that cost nothing, for example bonus shares: the gain is then the whole value and has no percentage).

name.description: `retrained_vs_frozen` (is retraining helping) or `retrained_vs_no_ml` (is the model helping).

verdict.description: `helps`, `hurts`, `no_measurable_difference`, `inconclusive` (fewer days than the minimum) or `unavailable`. "No measurable difference" is an answer.

meanDifference.description: First arm minus second arm, per candidate.

reason.description: Why it is unavailable, or null.

frozenMean.description: Mean value per candidate of arm A (frozen).

noMlMean.description: Arm C (no model, take every candidate).

oneOf.description: B minus A.
B minus C.

LoopArmsView.description: The three arms on the same candidates.

reason.description: Why it is unavailable, or null.

standardError.description: Its standard error per 50 rows, or null with three points.

projectedRows.description: Total rows at which the line reaches the target, or null.

moreRows.description: Rows beyond the last point, or null.

reason.description: Why it is unavailable, or null.

topTrades.description: Graded trades in the top half.

bottomTrades.description: Graded trades in the bottom half.

approvedTickets.description: Approved tickets that had a stored score.

approvedInTop.description: Of those, in the top half.

LoopReportView.description: "Is the learning loop helping?" (spec CF-12 D4 to D7). Report only.

LoopSettingsView.description: The settings that produced the loop figures.

reason.description: Why it is unavailable, or null.

LooseningSettingChangeView.description: One row of the setting history.

expectedVersion.description: The version read (0 when no row exists); another change in between is 409 plans.stale.

password.description: The owner's password for THIS change, ON or OFF. Missing: 403 auth.step_up_required.

LooseningSettingsChangeBody.description: The owner's change of the automatic dismissal setting. The actor is never taken from the body.

autoDismiss.description: The value; OFF while no row exists.

version.description: The newest row id; 0 when none.

hash.description: The hash of the newest row.

LooseningSettingsView.description: The automatic dismissal setting and its history (newest first, the latest 50).

key.description: The setting key, or for a budget the basket's name.

basketId.description: The basket of a budget; null otherwise.

LooseningView.description: One loosened limit a plan shows (BK-10b): computed on read from the stored change rows, never stored in the plan.

detail.description: The numbers behind it, as text.

skipped.description: Runs left out of the default set, each with the reason.

unavailableInputs.description: Inputs a figure would need that do not exist.

LossTagsEvidenceView.description: The evidence block of the loss tags.

state.description: `empty` when no run can be used, else `ok`.

comparisons.description: Cell and tag pairs the growing-tag detector compared.

expectedChanceFlags.description: Flags expected by chance alone at an assumed 5 per cent per comparison.

notBuilt.description: What the data cannot support yet, verbatim from the analyzer.

limits.description: Sentences that must be printed with the result.

newsResultsUnavailable.description: Losses that carry no `news_results` tag because their instrument's results events were not available (`news_results_unavailable`, P15-06); never "no news".

LossTagsView.description: The loss tags of the report population, as the screen shows them (P8-13). Computed on read from the closed trades of stored runs; nothing is stored or applied.

LotDateInput.description: Sets the acquisition date of a lot (between 1990-01-01 and today, India).

LotFeasibilityView.description: The paired trades with one lot-feasibility word, and their share of the paired trades.

LotRow.description:
A lot of a holding with its own figures: Invested is its cost, Value is its value now (open) or its sale proceeds (closed), Pnl the difference.
Status is "open" or "closed"; Source "import", "added" or "manual". Estimated: the sale price is the last price a sync saw.

maeEdges.description: Edges of the MAE bins in R.

resultEdges.description: Edges of the result bins in R.

belowCount.description: Trades below the first result edge.

aboveCount.description: Trades at or above the last result edge.

MaeGridView.description: Counts by MAE (rows; the last row is the last edge and above) and result R (columns; the first is below the first edge, the last at or above the last edge). The two counts repeat the totals of the tail columns.

excursionN.description: Trades with a recorded MAE and MFE: the n behind every count.

winnersMaeP90.description: Nearest-rank 90th percentile of the MAE of winners, or its state.

oneOf.description: MAE by result counts; null for a non-value group.
The MFE histogram; null for a non-value group.

reachedMfe.description: Trades that reached 1, 2 and 3 R at some point; empty for a non-value group.

MaeMfeGroupView.description: The excursions of one group. The grid, the histogram and the levels exist only for a group that is a value; otherwise `WinnersMaeP90` holds the reason.

ManualTradeInput.description:
A trade typed in by the owner: for a holding (`HoldingId`) or for a security of an account (`AccountId` and `Symbol` and/or `Isin`, which must be an NSE share or ETF of the master list). `Side` buy or sell, the date not in the
future, `Quantity` a whole number above 0, `Price` above 0, `Charges` optional (0).

MembersOrderInput.description: Every member of the basket exactly once, in the wanted order.

MessageView.description: A stored message. For an assistant message: the finish reason, the grounding status with the spans, the tokens and times, and its tool calls. For a user message: NoAnswerStored is true when the turn has no assistant message (a crash mid-turn).

MetaFoldView.description: One fold of a stored policy evaluation.

MetaPolicyKnobsView.description: The knobs a meta-policy evaluation was made with.

id.description: The row id; null inside the stored JSON.

outcome.description: NoPolicy, NotEnoughEvidence, DoesNotHelp, Inconclusive or Helps.

from.description: Earliest trade date; null with no trades.

pooled.description: Kept and skipped pooled over the evaluable folds (out of sample).

recent.description: The same over the last evaluated trades.

policy.description: The thresholds proposed (chosen in-sample, so optimistic).

limits.description: Sentences that must be shown with the result.

builtBy.description: Who stored it; null inside the stored JSON.

createdAt.description: When; null inside the stored JSON.

MetaPolicyReportView.description: A stored meta-labelling policy evaluation as the API shows it (`schemaVersion` 1). `NoPolicy` is stored like any other result.

MetaThresholdView.description: A threshold of one group; a null threshold takes everything.

MetaTotalsView.description: Kept and skipped R of a set of candidates.

state.description: One of value, provisional, insufficient, unavailable, not_evaluable, empty.

number.description: The number; null unless the state is value or provisional.

reason.description: Why the figure is not a plain value; null for a value.

MetricView.description: One reported figure on the wire (P8-00 D3): a state and, only for `value` and `provisional`, a number. For every other state (`insufficient`, `unavailable`, `not_evaluable`, `empty`) the number is absent and the reason says why; a screen draws a word, never a digit.

aboveCount.description: Trades at or above the last edge.

MfeHistogramView.description: Counts by MFE: one bin between each pair of edges, then the open bin at or above the last edge.

trades.description: Real trades that got a mirror trade.

mirrorMeanR.description: Mean net R of the mirror trades; null when unavailable.

realMeanR.description: Mean net R of the real trades, beside it.

comparison.description: How the value is read against the threshold (`<=`).

MirrorView.description: The mirror gate of one Lab verdict (CF-07, D3): the net expectancy of the real trades taken the other way round with the same costs must be at most double MirrorView.Threshold (0). A positive mirror reads "mostly drift". `unavailable` is never a pass.

MissingMinute.description: A missing minute: the India date and the minute (`HH:mm`).

family.description: The model family whose one look it is.

blockStart.description: The start of the block the look was taken on, or null before a look.

rows.description: Hold-out rows the model was scored on, or null when not available.

probabilityBeatsNoMl.description: The probability of beating the best no-ML baseline there, or null when not available.

policyEffectR.description: The effect of the take rule on realised R there, or null when not available.

MlHoldOutView.description: Where the model stands with the locked hold-out.

mayInfluence.description: True only when every term holds and the model is the current champion; false by default.

reasons.description: Every reason of every term that does not hold, plus `not_champion`; empty only when allowed.

settingHash.description: SHA-256 of the thresholds and the switch.

notes.description: What a reader must know about the figures that are not available.

MlInfluenceView.description: `GET /api/learning/models/{id}/influence`: whether the model may influence a decision, term by term (CF-10 part 10c-2, ADR 0217).

MlReasonView.description: One reason a term of the influence predicate does not hold.

switches.description: The three switches now in force.

changed.description: The names of the switches this call changed.

influenceEnabled.description: `ml.influence.enabled` (default OFF): whether a model may influence a decision at all. ON needs a fresh password; it opens nothing alone (the predicate's other terms must hold too).

autoPromote.description: `ml.auto_promote` (default OFF): whether the daily run may promote a challenger whose promotion rule and predicate terms hold. ON needs a fresh password.

autoRollback.description: `ml.auto_rollback` (default OFF): whether the daily run may execute a rollback proposal. It lowers reliance on ML, so it needs the session and the CSRF token and no password.

password.description: The owner's password, re-entered for THIS change. Required when the change turns ml.influence.enabled or ml.auto_promote ON (missing: 403 auth.step_up_required; wrong: 401, counted toward the lockout); ignored otherwise.

MlSettingsRequest.description: The body of a change of the ML switches. The owner is never part of it: the actor comes from the signed-in session. A switch that is not given is left alone.

influenceSettingId.description: Its row in force, or null when none was ever stored.

autoPromoteSettingId.description: Its row in force, or null.

autoRollbackSettingId.description: Its row in force, or null.

MlSettingsView.description: The three ML switches as they stand (all default OFF).

id.description: The row in force, or null when none was ever stored.

MlSwitchState.description: One of the three ML switches as stored: the newest row of its name, OFF with no id when none exists.

MlSwitches.description: The three ML switches as they stand (spec CF-10 D6 to D8): all default OFF.

state.description: `holds`, `fails` or `unavailable` (an unavailable figure is not a pass).

reasons.description: Why not; empty when it holds.

MlTermView.description: One term of the influence predicate.

reportText.description: The validation report with its honest limits.

importance.description: The features by weight, largest first.

limits.description: The sentences that must be read with the model.

ModelDetailView.description: A model with everything the registry keeps about it (P6-07).

sha256.description: The hash of the model file.

trainingSetId.description: The training set it was made from.

note.description: What a reader must know about the fit, or null.

fitRows.description: Rows the trees were fitted on.

calibrationRows.description: Rows the calibration was fitted on.

trainRows.description: Development rows it was trained on.

holdOutStart.description: First day of the hold-out that was not read, or null when none was kept.

foldsBeatingBoth.description: Folds in which it beat both baselines.

pooledEcePp.description: Pooled expected calibration error in percentage points.

reasons.description: Why it is not eligible; empty when eligible.

role.description: The current role: challenger, champion or retired.

mayBeChampion.description: The record allows the role champion: an Eligible verdict, a hold-out kept, enough folds and the trials of the registry.

ModelView.description: A registered model as the API shows it (P6-07, ADR 0070): what made it, what the harness said about it and its current role. No model bytes.

ModifyTicketRequest.description: The body of a modification: sizes can only be reduced; nothing else can be edited.

MonteCarloBlockView.description:
The stationary block bootstrap of the out-of-sample trades by entry session (CF-03, ADR 0205), beside MonteCarloView, which stays as it was. Every figure is null when it could not be computed and string MonteCarloBlockView.Note then starts with `unavailable:`.
`WidthRatioToIid` is the width of this interval (5th to 95th percentile of the mean) over the width of the iid one: above 1 means same-day and serial clustering widen the interval.

MonteCarloView.description: The bootstrap of the out-of-sample trades; the seed is text (a 64-bit number). `DrawdownP90` (SC-S1, ADR 0222) is null in a result stored before it.

to.description: `approved`, `rejected`, `expired` or `accepted` (running and judged have their own commands).

password.description: The owner's password, typed again for THIS act.

MoveHypothesisRequest.description: The body of a hypothesis move.

NameLearning.description: Names a depository or demat file teaches: `Known` are remembered already, `New` would be remembered by an import.

reason.description: Why net figures are unavailable; null when they are not.

confirmed.description: What the owner confirmed, as text; null when nothing is confirmed.

NetBasisView.description: Whether a net report can be made at all (P8-00 question 19): `value` when the owner's stored confirmation of the charge sheet exists, otherwise `unavailable` with the reason. The confirmation is read from storage; a request cannot supply it.

mode.description: The mode when it was computed.

enforce.description: Whether the null could cap the outcome.

settings.description: The text of the settings that produced the figures.

capped.description: True when the outcome was capped at MARGINAL by an enforced null.

basis.description: What the null is made over: the development window, the in-sample walk and the cost sheet.

notes.description: The limits of the figure and the reasons trades were left out.

oneOf.description: The rank of the strategy among the 20 placebo shapes (CF-07 part B); null in a result stored before it or when `Confidence:Nulls:Placebos` is off.
The mirror gate (CF-07 part B); null as Placebos.
The plateau gate on the swept parameters (CF-07 part C); null in a result stored before it or when `Confidence:Plateau:Mode` is Off.

NullsView.description:
The chance tests of a Lab verdict (CF-07, ADRs 0208 and 0209), shown beside PASS/MARGINAL/FAIL: report-only unless the owner turns `Enforce` on, then a null, a placebo set or a mirror gate that is not a pass caps a PASS at MARGINAL and never raises an outcome.
The plateau gate on parameters (CF-07 part C, ADR 0210) sits in the same block as `Plateau`, with a mode and an enforce switch of its own.

OfficialDailyCheck.description: The comparison of the derived daily bar with the broker's official daily candle: not available until official daily candles are fetched.

OpeningBarsRecorderView.description: The recorder as the owner sees it: the stored switch (`false` when never set), the state word of its last run (null when it never ran), when that was, the reasons it is not running now and the last 50 changes. Same shape as the other recorders' views.

enabled.description: The new value of the owner's switch: ON allows the recorder to run (when the deployment flag and the service are on too), OFF stops it.

password.description: The owner's password, re-entered for THIS change - ON or OFF. It is checked on every request (a step-up window opened earlier does not count and is not used up or extended); wrong ones count toward the sign-in lockout.

OpeningBarsSwitchRequest.description: The body of the opening-minute recorder switch. The owner is never part of it: the actor comes from the signed-in session.

OpeningBarsSwitched.description: The answer of a switch change: the row and the new value.

OpeningQtyView.description: The quantity the lots count as opening (the shares the trades do not explain): now, and after the rebuild. Null where it cannot be told (no holding, or a quantity that is not whole after a split or bonus).

OptionArchiveSummaryView.description: The option archive per underlying (spec P14-16); an empty list when nothing is stored.

note.description: What was read and where it is recorded (ADR 0177), 1 to 500 characters.

password.description: The owner's password, re-entered for THIS act. It is checked on every request.

OptionBackfillProbeRequest.description: The body of the acceptance of the probe result. The owner is never part of it: the actor comes from the signed-in session.

OptionBackfillProgressView.description: How far the backfill is: the keys the plan has, finished, empty, answered "no data", given up and left, and the hours the left keys need at the current rate (null until the feed host reported progress). Counts only.

enabled.description: The new value of the owner's switch: ON allows the backfill to run (when the deployment flag, the probe acceptance and the service are on too), OFF stops it.

password.description: The owner's password, re-entered for THIS change - ON or OFF. It is checked on every request (a step-up window opened earlier does not count and is not used up or extended); wrong ones count toward the sign-in lockout.

OptionBackfillSwitchRequest.description: The body of the expired-options backfill switch. The owner is never part of it: the actor comes from the signed-in session.

OptionBackfillSwitched.description: The answer of a switch change: the row and the new value.

OptionBackfillView.description:
The backfill as the owner sees it: the stored switch (`false` when never set), its history (newest first, the latest 50), the probe acceptance (null = not accepted), the state word of the heartbeat (null when the feed host never reported), the progress
and the reasons it is not running now. Nothing in it is a bar.

OptionChainRecorderSwitched.description: The answer of a switch change: the row and the new value.

OptionChainRecorderView.description:
The recorder as the owner sees it: the stored switch (`false` when never set), its history (newest first, the latest 50), the state word of the recorder's heartbeat (null when the feed host never reported) and the reasons it is not running now.
Nothing in it is chain data.

enabled.description: The new value of the owner's switch: ON allows the recorder to run (when the deployment flag and the service are on too), OFF stops it.

password.description: The owner's password, re-entered for THIS change - ON or OFF. It is checked on every request (a step-up window opened earlier does not count and is not used up or extended); wrong ones count toward the sign-in lockout.

OptionChainSwitchRequest.description: The body of the option-chain recorder switch. The owner is never part of it: the actor comes from the signed-in session.

OptionCoverageCheckView.description: One check of a session as the API shows it: the code, the status word (`pass`, `warn`, `fail`, `unavailable`), the measured share, the threshold it was judged by and the reason. No price, IV or Greek.

OptionCoverageSessionView.description: One session of the archive: a chain session of the underlying, or one rolling series (FetchKey) on a day.

OptionCoverageView.description: The checked sessions of one underlying in a range and the cumulative count of usable chain sessions up to the end of the range (the number P14-07 compares with 60). Truncated is true when more rolling sessions exist than are listed.

OverlapView.description: How much two baskets share: the Jaccard index of their member sets.

OverviewAccount.description: One account on Today. string OverviewAccount.Mode is the effective mode and DateTimeOffset? OverviewAccount.EffectiveFrom the time its trail row took effect (null: never changed from the configured one).

OverviewCaps.description: The four meters of an account against the sheet in force; LimitsRowView? OverviewCaps.PendingLimits is the raise that waits for its time, shown beside it.

count.description: How many of the newest records have it.

OverviewCount.description: A name and how many records carry it (P6-18).

label.description: Role of a model, knob of an experiment, kind of a changelog row.

verdict.description: The stored verdict, outcome or state after.

detail.description: One line of the stored numbers.

OverviewHeadline.description: The newest record of one kind, as the overview shows it (P6-18): what it is, the verdict that was stored and one line of the stored numbers. Nothing here is computed.

counted.description: Records counted: at most the newest int GetLearningOverviewHandler.CountLimit.

truncated.description: True when there may be more records than were counted.

split.description: The count by role (models), outcome (experiments) or state (hypotheses, lessons); only names that occur.

oneOf.description: The newest record, or null when none is stored.
For models, the current champion; null otherwise or when there is none.

OverviewSection.description: One kind of learning record in the overview (P6-18): how many were counted, the split by role, outcome or state, and the newest record.

password.description: The owner's password, typed again for THIS act and checked on every request (an earlier step-up window does not count and is not used up).

OwnerMoveRequest.description: The body of a lesson close or dismiss and of a changelog revert (P8-19). The actor, a state and any number are never part of it: a field the server does not read is ignored.

countsAsPass.description: Whether row 15's P3-09 term now reads pass (newest record, PASS, at least 20 trades).

PackGateRecorded.description: The answer of a record: the row and whether it counts as a pass for row 15.

strategyId.description: The strategy the pack was run for.

packId.description: The pack folder's id as the gate printed it (1 to 100 characters).

status.description: The gate's status in its own spelling: PASS, PASS_WITH_DATA_FINDINGS, RERUN_NEEDED, DATA_REPAIR_NEEDED or BLOCKED_DEFECT. Only PASS over at least 20 trades counts.

password.description: The owner's password, re-entered for THIS record. Missing: 403 auth.step_up_required; wrong: 401 auth.invalid_credentials.

PackGateResultRequest.description: The body of the owner's record of a `verify-pack --gate` result. The owner is never part of it: the actor comes from the signed-in session.

PairFormationList.description: The stored formations whose window overlaps the range, oldest quarter first; State is `unavailable` with the reason `no_runs` when none is stored. Truncated is true when more than 400 formations overlap the range: the oldest 400 are listed.

PairFormationSummary.description: One stored formation of a quarter (spec P14-16): the candidates, the tested, the unavailable, the selected, the Benjamini-Hochberg threshold at its last rejection and the half-life distribution. No spread, price or test statistic.

PaperAccountList.description: The paper accounts with the label every paper response carries.

epochId.description: The epoch; null before the first capture.

capital.description: The capital; null when the account has none (BrokerFunds).

fundsAvailable.description: Equity less the open notional, at least 0.

unrealised.description: Rupees at the marks; unavailable when any mark is, empty without a position.

lastSessionResult.description: Realised rupees of the last closed session (0 when no trade closed).

lastSessionPct.description: That result, signed percent of the equity at the start of the session.

maxDrawdownClosed.description: Closed-trade drawdown of the realised result.

PaperAccountView.description: One paper account's ledger, every figure derived from its stored trades and labelled as paper (spec P10-02).

id.description: The sheet id; null when no closed trade was charged.

confirmedOn.description: Always null in this view (spec P10-02, criterion 5).

PaperChargeSheetView.description: The sheet that charged the account's closed trades. The confirmation is unreadable here, so DateOnly? PaperChargeSheetView.ConfirmedOn is always null.

charges.description: Rupees of charges; null when none.

result.description: Rupees after the stored charges (gross where none).

PaperClosedTradeView.description: One closed paper trade in the ledger.

pct.description: Percent of the capital plus the peak.

PaperDrawdownView.description: The largest fall of the running realised result from its peak.

PaperEntryList.description: The paper entries with the label and the limits every paper response carries.

qty.description: The owner's quantity after any size-down.

entryAt.description: The start of the fill minute.

oneOf.description: The exit, or null while the trade is open.

costBasis.description: What the exit's rupees and R are net of; the gross label while the trade is open.

PaperEntryView.description: One paper trade of one account. It is a replay: no order was placed or exists (string PaperEntryView.Basis).

realised.description: The realised result up to and including the session.

PaperEquityPoint.description: One point of the realised-equity line.

epochId.description: The epoch; null before the first capture.

PaperEquityView.description: The realised-equity line of a paper account, one point per trading session from the epoch's start.

epochStartedOn.description: The epoch's first session; null before the first capture.

lastClosedSession.description: The session the marks and the last-session result are as of.

exitAt.description: The start of the exit minute.

heldSessions.description: Sessions held, entry and exit session included.

grossPnl.description: Rupees before charges at the owner's quantity.

charges.description: Rupees of charges; null without a sheet.

netPnl.description: Gross less charges; null without a sheet.

rSim.description: R of the trade: net when charged, else gross (the grade's R).

PaperExitView.description: The exit of a paper trade as the API shows it (spec P10-01).

asOf.description: The date of the bar read; null when none.

reason.description: Why unavailable; null for a value.

PaperMarkView.description: The mark of an open position: a value with its close and date, or unavailable with the reason and no price.

report.description: The criteria, the weeks, the epochs, what is printed and the limits.

PaperPhaseCheckView.description: The paper phase check as the verb prints it and the endpoint returns it.

oneOf.description: The epoch judged; null before the first capture.

elapsedDays.description: Days from the epoch start to Through, both included.

exitVerdict.description: The bare word: MET, NOT MET or NOT EVALUABLE.

exitCriterion.description: The same call with its caveats, e.g. MET (point estimate; ...).

printed.description: What is printed and not judged.

PaperPhaseReport.description: The paper phase check (spec P10-06, ADR 0123): the P10 exit judged from stored records, with its caveats in the label.

asOfSession.description: The session the marks are as of.

PaperPositionList.description: The open positions and the closed trades of a paper account.

unrealised.description: Rupees at the mark; unavailable with the mark.

riskAmount.description: Rupees at risk to the initial stop.

riskPctOfEquity.description: Risk as a percent of equity.

heldSessions.description: Sessions held, entry and last closed session included.

charges.description: Rupees of charges; null when no closed trade was charged.

net.description: The result after the stored charges (gross where no sheet charged).

basis.description: gross, no charges / after the stored sheet / mixed, in words.

PaperRealisedView.description: The realised result of a paper account. decimal PaperRealisedView.Net is gross less the stored sheet's charges where a closed trade was charged; string PaperRealisedView.Basis says what it is after and that the sheet is not confirmed here (ISS-25).

epochId.description: The epoch; null before the first capture.

differences.description: Each difference, in words (empty when ok).

PaperReconcileView.description: Whether the derived ledger agrees with the stored rows.

PaperReviewList.description: The stored reviews, newest week first.

PaperReviewListItem.description: One row of the list of stored reviews.

id.description: The row id; null for a dry run that stored nothing.

epochId.description: The epoch; null when there is none yet.

builtBy.description: Who built it; null for a dry run.

stored.description: Whether this is the stored record.

repeated.description: The week already had a review: that one is shown and nothing was written.

PaperReviewView.description: A weekly paper review as the API and the verb show it.

ParameterSensitivityView.description: The sweep of one parameter and its judgement (`stable`, `fragile`, `no_base_edge`, `inconclusive`).

ParameterView.description: A parameter of a service with its schema: `kind` integer · number · boolean, the bounds of a number, the current value and the default.

mode.description: The mode when it was computed.

variants.description: The variants compared: the base run and the sweep points that ran at least one trade.

blocks.description: S, the blocks the window was cut into.

splits.description: The splits tried, `C(S, S/2)`; 0 when unavailable.

pbo.description: The share of splits in which the in-sample best variant is at or below the out-of-sample median.

medianLogit.description: The median logit of the out-of-sample rank over the splits (below 0: the winner tends to fall below the median).

maxPbo.description: The limit the Gate compares with; it decides nothing outside Gate mode.

metric.description: `Mean` or `Sharpe`: what picks and ranks the best variant.

capped.description: True when a PASS was capped at MARGINAL by this figure (Gate mode only).

settings.description: The settings that produced the figure.

note.description: The reading and the honest limits, or the unavailable reason.

PboView.description:
The probability of backtest overfitting of the sweep (CF-03 part B, ADR 0228), shown beside the verdict. Every figure is null when it could not be computed and string PboView.Note then starts with `unavailable:`; an unavailable figure never moves an outcome.
`Capped` is true only when the owner's Gate mode capped a PASS at MARGINAL because of it.

before.description: The value in the last snapshot.

meaning.description: would restart the count, or noted only.

PendingChangeView.description: A difference the next capture would see.

verdict.description: MET, NOT MET or NOT EVALUABLE.

label.description: The call and its reason in one line.

blockers.description: What stops it and whose act it is; empty when nothing does.

PhaseCriterion.description: One criterion of the paper phase check (spec P10-06): a verdict, the fact in words, the facts behind it and what stops it.

current.description: True for the epoch judged; earlier epochs are never pooled into it.

PhaseEpochLine.description: An epoch of the history, with whether it is the one judged.

PhaseFact.description: string PhaseFact.State is `value`, `empty`, `insufficient` or `unavailable`; the text carries the n. Printed beside the verdict, never part of it.

proof.description: The test names (or where it is settled).

PhaseNotJudged.description: A thing the check never judges, and the tests that prove it.

disciplineLines.description: The discipline lines of P10-03, one each.

sensitivityMean.description: The plan-price mean over all primary proposals (P10-04), in words.

plansWithoutPrimary.description: Sessions whose plan had no primary ticket.

manualRuns.description: Manual nightly attempts in the window.

p7.description: The P7 phase check's label, or why it is unavailable.

chargeSheetConfirmed.description: Whether the owner confirmed the charge sheet(s) of the counted trades.

blockers.description: Every blocker, with whose act it is.

notJudged.description: What the check does not judge.

PhasePrinted.description: What is printed beside the criteria and never judged by them.

role.description: What it is for in one phrase.

required.description: True when criterion 1 cannot be met without it.

PhaseService.description: A service of the framework and whether it runs.

effect.description: What it does, in a phrase, and whether the exit needs it.

needed.description: True when the pipeline cannot publish real tickets without it.

sessions.description: Trading sessions of the week inside the window.

captureFinished.description: Sessions whose capture finished with nothing pending.

tradesCounted.description: Trades counted that week (by exit day).

cumulativeCounted.description: Counted trades up to the end of the week.

PhaseWeekLine.description: One ISO week of the epoch.

row.description: The row value; null when not recorded.

column.description: The column value; null when not recorded.

PivotCellView.description: One cell of a pivot: the trade count and one figure. A cell with no trade is `empty`, a cell below the minimum is `insufficient` (masked, with its count), never a zero.

rows.description: The row values, sorted; null is "not recorded" (last).

nonAdditive.description: A trade appears in more than one cell.

PivotView.description: A pivot of two dimensions by one figure: the row and column values and every cell of the grid, row by row, empty cells included so no gap reads as a zero.

trades.description: Real trades that got a placebo trade of this shape.

meanR.description: Mean net R of those placebo trades after the same charges; null when none.

rank.description: Its place among the strategy and the comparable placebos, 1 the best; null when it is not comparable.

comparable.description: True when enough trades were placed for it to be ranked.

reason.description: Why it is not comparable; null when it is.

PlaceboRowView.description: One placebo shape in the ranking of a Lab verdict (CF-07, D2).

minComparable.description: The fewest comparable shapes for a conclusive reading.

realMeanR.description: Mean net R of the real trades that were restated.

realRank.description: The strategy's rank among the comparable placebos and itself; null when unavailable.

comparison.description: How the value is read against the threshold (`<=`).

rows.description: One row per shape, in the fixed order; empty when nothing could be walked.

PlaceboSetView.description:
The placebo set of one Lab verdict (CF-07, D2): the real strategy against 20 fixed shapes (the mirror, entries 15 to 60 minutes later, the same clock time on sessions 1 to 5 away either side, the signals reassigned to the next 1 to 5 instruments). The strategy must rank
first: double? PlaceboSetView.PValue is `rank / (comparable + 1)` against double PlaceboSetView.Threshold; with fewer than int PlaceboSetView.MinComparable comparable placebos the reading is `unavailable` (inconclusive) and never a pass.

PlanAlertsView.description:
The alerts of a plan. `enabled` is the setting `Planning:TicketAlerts:Enabled`; when false the lists are empty. `mutedItems` are the tickets whose further crossings the owner stopped. Armed means watched; every text ends with
the fact that no order is placed.

itemId.description: The item, or null for the plan.

approvalId.description: The approval row of an owner decision.

conservativeExpectancyR.description: Conservative expectancy in R, or null.

advisoryNote.description: A model's figure, labelled advisory, or null.

PlanEvidenceView.description: The evidence of a ticket, with its limits.

gate.description: normal, reduced, no_trade, unavailable or off.

gateMissing.description: Gate inputs that were not known.

ruleRemovedHalf.description: Whether a rule removed half or more of the candidates it saw.

costBasis.description: gross, costed_unconfirmed, net_confirmed, mixed or unknown.

PlanFlagsView.description: The smart-rule and data states of a plan as stored facts (spec P8-14, ADR 0113). The banner holds the full text of every flag line as it was written when the plan was published.

report.description: The curves and groups of this plan.

state.description: The ticket state; null for a rejected candidate, which is not a ticket.

nextStates.description: States the ticket may move to; empty for a rejected candidate.

oneOf.description: Indicative numbers as of the close of D (P7-19), or null for a plan stored without them or a ticket with no numeric level.
What the down-only size scaling did (BK-10), or null when nothing acted.

discretionary.description: The day's fills with no ticket, reported separately.

ticketsWithoutFills.description: Approved tickets that no fill was matched to.

PlanNotice.description:
One thing about the plan the owner should know. `kind`: plan_awaiting_review · plan_nightly_failed · plan_tickets_lapsed · plan_tickets_armed · plan_tickets_invalidated · plan_fills_unmatched · ticket_level_crossed · post_trade_prompt (these two are carried from P7-20 as it derives them, only while ticket alerts are enabled; their ids are `crossing:{id}` and `prompt:{id}`) · compliance_recheck_overdue (carried from P11-05: the newest compliance record of a kind has a review date that has passed; id `compliance:overdue:{kind}:{yyyy-MM-dd}`, route `/live?tab=compliance`, resolved by a newer record of the kind).
`severity`: error · warning · info. `id` carries what changes, so a worse or bigger situation is unread again: `plan:review:{planId}:{info|warning}`, `plan:{lapsed|armed|invalidated|fills|fills-ambiguous}:{planId}:{count}`, `plan:nightly:{yyyy-MM-dd}:{attempt}`. `route` is an in-app path (`/plans?plan={id}`, or `/plans`
for a run that failed closed and so has no plan); there is no command: the notice only shows and opens. `at` is the moment it is about (the cutoff, the end of the failed run), or null. `since` is when the situation began and `resolved` marks a carried ticket notice that has closed but is still shown for a day (plan items just disappear). The text has counts, never a symbol, a size or a price.

PlanNotices.description: The current plan notices, worst first. An item is present while its cause stands and absent once the stored state has changed.

report.description: The criteria, the sessions, the setup and the limits.

PlanPhaseCheckView.description: The phase check as the verb prints it and the endpoint returns it.

number.description: 1 to 12, as numbered in the P7-00 spec.

name.description: The criterion in the spec's words.

verdict.description: MET, NOT MET or NOT EVALUABLE.

caveat.description: What a MET rests on without being verified here, printed beside the label; null when none.

PlanPhaseCriterion.description: One acceptance criterion of P7-00 with the call and the numbers behind it.

through.description: The last planned session of the window.

streak.description: Consecutive counted sessions ending at DateOnly PlanPhaseReport.Through.

exitVerdict.description: The bare call on the roadmap exit (criterion 1): MET, NOT MET or NOT EVALUABLE; MET only after ten consecutive scheduled published sessions.

exitCriterion.description: The same call as printed, with its caveat in the label (for example "MET (COUNT ONLY: all 10 plans are empty, no ticket was ever proposed)").

sessions.description: The sessions of the window, oldest first.

blockers.description: Which switches and services are still off, and why the run cannot yet happen; empty when none.

PlanPhaseReport.description: The P7 phase check: the acceptance criteria, the ten sessions, the setup and the limits that are always printed.

scheduledRuns.description: Attempts started by the schedule or its catch-up.

primary.description: Primary tickets, or null without a plan.

zeroPrimary.description: True when the plan has no primary ticket.

skeleton.description: True when the plan is the empty skeleton.

finishedAt.description: When the deciding attempt finished, or null.

note.description: Why the session does or does not count.

PlanPhaseSession.description: One planned session of the window.

reviewCutoff.description: Approvals and modifications are refused from this time; undecided tickets lapse.

open.description: Whether decisions can still be taken now (plan open and before the cutoff).

notice.description: What an approval means: watched, no order.

attempt.description: 1 for the first attempt of the planned session.

planKey.description: The plan key when a plan was published.

failedGate.description: The gate that blocked, or null.

volScale.description: The volatility scale applied (floor to 1.0); null when not applied or unavailable.

gateScale.description: The gate's scale, 0.75 in reduced mode, else 1.

factor.description: min(volatility scale, gate scale) times the budget ratio, at most 1.

capacityShares.description: The capacity cap in shares; null when off or unavailable.

budgetRoom.description: The room left in the tightest basket budget, percent of capital; null when there is no budget or it is unavailable.

budgetUsesPct.description: Share of that budget used after this ticket; null as above.

settingsVersion.description: The newest settings row id the scaling read (0 when none).

text.description: The same in words, for the ticket.

PlanSizingNote.description: What the down-only size scaling did to a ticket (spec BK-10, AC 10), stored as JSON on the plan item. Every figure is a factor at most 1 or a count; none is an amount of capital.

reviewCutoff.description: After this an owner approval or modification is refused; undecided tickets lapse.

state.description: draft, published, inreview, approved, rejected, lapsed, armed or expired.

nextStates.description: The states the plan may move to.

provisional.description: Whether cells were not yet paper-proven.

items.description: The candidates; empty in a list.

history.description: The trail, oldest first; empty in a list.

oneOf.description: The smart-rule and data states stored with the plan (P8-14); null for a plan stored before them.

loosenings.description: The loosened limits this plan shows (BK-10b), oldest first: computed on read from the stored change rows, never part of the stored plan or its hash. Empty when none, or in a plan read where they could not be read (see bool PlanView.LooseningsUnavailable).

looseningsUnavailable.description: True when the loosenings could not be read: the screen says so instead of showing nothing.

PlanView.description: A plan as the API shows it (P7-03, ADR 0083): header, current state, the sentences it carries as data, and for one plan the tickets and the trail.

uncertain.description: Fills that may not be the ticket's alone: no R.

notFinished.description: Position still open or grade not there yet.

PlanVsActualCounts.description: How the approved ticket lines divide (P8-04). A graded line with a zero or missing planned risk per share is counted under `NoPlanLevels`.

basis.description: Text: realised fills beside simulated plan prices.

provisional.description: A plan read is marked provisional.

PlanVsActualEvidenceView.description: The evidence block of plan versus actual (P8-04).

PlanVsActualNotDecomposed.description: A part of the gap that is never given a number, with the reason (P8-04).

step.description: plan_prices, entry_slippage, charges, not_attributed or actual.

PlanVsActualStrategyView.description: Plan versus actual of one strategy (P8-04).

plans.description: Plans read (the newest version of each session).

counts.description: How the approved ticket lines divide.

approvals.description: Approve decisions by kind, from the stored approval rows.

chain.description: The steps from plan R to actual R; empty states carry no number.

missed.description: Triggered tickets without a fill, outside the chain.

notDecomposed.description: Parts never given a number, with the reason.

PlanVsActualView.description: Plan versus actual on the wire (P8-04).

validPoints.description: Valid points, the declared value included.

baseMeanR.description: Net expectancy at the declared value.

lowerValue.description: The swept value just below the declared one.

lowerRetention.description: Its mean over the base mean.

upperValue.description: The swept value just above the declared one.

upperRetention.description: Its mean over the base mean.

median.description: Median net expectancy over the valid points.

centreValue.description: The value maximizing the mean of itself and its two neighbours.

PlateauParameterView.description:
The plateau reading of one swept parameter (CF-07, D4): the two points next to the declared value must each keep the retention of the base and the median over the valid points must be above 0. string PlateauParameterView.Reading is `plateau`, `spike`,
`no_base_edge` or `inconclusive`; string PlateauParameterView.Status is `pass`, `fail` or `unavailable`. The centre is reported, never applied.

declared.description: True for the value the strategy declares (the base run).

meanR.description: Net expectancy of the run; null when it gave no trade or was refused.

retention.description: Its mean over the base mean; null when either cannot be read or the base is not above 0.

error.description: Why the engine refused the run; null otherwise.

PlateauPointView.description: One point of a parameter's curve in the plateau gate (CF-07, D4): the declared value is marked.

mode.description: The mode when it was computed.

enforce.description: Whether the gate could cap the outcome.

settings.description: The text of the settings that produced the figures.

retention.description: The share of the base each neighbour must keep (the threshold).

minPoints.description: The fewest valid points of a parameter for a reading.

comparison.description: How a neighbour's retention is read against the threshold (`>=`).

capped.description: True when the outcome was capped at MARGINAL by the enforced gate.

basis.description: What the figure is made over: the in-sample sweep, its window and the exit.

PlateauView.description:
The plateau gate of a Lab verdict (CF-07 part C, ADR 0210), read from the stored points of the in-sample sweep (no new simulation): string PlateauView.Status is `pass` only when every swept parameter sits on a plateau, `fail` when one does not, and
`unavailable` (never a pass) when one has no reading or the strategy sweeps none. Report-only beside PASS/MARGINAL/FAIL unless the owner turns `Plateau:Enforce` on.

PooledFigureView.description: A pooled out-of-sample figure: the number of trades and the mean and score as states (a number only for a value).

PortfolioHistory.description:
The value history of a scope (all accounts that count in totals, one account, one bucket). `Points` are in date order at `Resolution` (`day`, `week` or `month`: the last trading day of the period); `Value` is what the
lots held that day were worth at that day's close (adjusted for splits and bonuses), `Invested` what they cost, `BenchmarkValue` the same cash flows in the benchmark index, `Nav` and `BenchmarkNav` unit values starting at 100
that cash flows do not move. `Coverage` says how many open holdings have price history; `Partial` is true when anything is left out (holdings without bars, history that starts late). `MaxDrawdown` / `BenchmarkMaxDrawdown`: the largest
fall of the NAV measured within the requested range (`Pct` 12.5 = fell 12.5 %; the peak must lie inside the range too) between the peak on `From` and the low on `To`, daily, whatever the resolution; `RangeFrom` and `RangeTo` are the first and
the last day of that range as returned (null when there is no point). `FirstDate` is the first day of the whole history (before the range is cut). `LastPriceAt` is set when the last point is today's live one: the time of the newest price in it.

PortfolioInput.description: The portfolio configuration to change. Every field that is left out (null) keeps the account's current value, on update. DefaultBucket: the name of the bucket imports go to — a custom bucket's name; an empty string "" (or the name of the account's own "{account name} · Portfolio" bucket) selects the account's own default bucket; null or omitted keeps the current choice. IncludeInTotals: true or false; null keeps it. At account creation, omitted means the account's own bucket and true. The automatic holdings refresh: RefreshMode "off" or "daily"; RefreshDailyTimeIst "HH:mm" (India time); left out keeps the current value (a new account: off, 16:00). FirstImportDate (not in the future, not before 1990-01-01) is the date the first import gives holdings without a date of their own. FirstImport is honoured only when updating the portfolio settings of an account (it is ignored at account creation): see FirstImportInput.

PortfolioNotice.description: One notice of the Portfolio module for the top-bar bell. `Kind` is `price_alert_triggered` (`Severity` warn; `AlertId` and `InstrumentId` set), `actions_need_decision` (info) or - since ADR 0027 - an attention item: `reconnect_dhan`, `sync_failing`, `holdings_need_review`, `trades_unexplained`, `dividends_pending`, `securities_unmatched` or `rows_dropped` (`Severity` error, warning or info; `AccountId` set). `Id` is stable and, for an attention item, includes its situation, so a changed situation is a new item and the bell keeps what was read by id. Since ADR 0027 every notice also has a `Title`, at most two `Actions` (a route to open or an existing endpoint to call), `Since` (when it was first seen; null for a notice derived on read that is not remembered - `actions_need_decision` - whose id already changes with the India date, so a client that keys read state on id and since sees the same key on every poll) and `Resolved`: an attention item whose condition stopped holding is kept for 24 hours with `Resolved` true and then dropped; resolved items are not counted in the badge. `At` is kept as it was (the time of the event, or `Since` for an attention item).

PortfolioSaved.description: The answer of saving the portfolio settings: the account as saved and what the first import did (always present; see FirstImportView).

PortfolioSettingsView.description:
Portfolio configuration. DefaultBucket is the name of the bucket imports go to (the account's own default bucket unless a custom bucket was chosen);
AutoBucketName is the name of the account's own default bucket ("{account name} · Portfolio") — the one that exists, or, while the account has none yet,
the name it would get now (with a numeric suffix when the plain name is taken); it is chosen for real when the role is switched on.
The holdings refresh by themselves according to RefreshMode: "off" (default) or "daily" (once a day from RefreshDailyTimeIst, "HH:mm" India time, default 16:00;
the time is kept while the mode is off). FirstImportDate is the date holdings get when they are imported for the first time without a date of their own
(2025-01-01 until the owner chooses another). HasHoldings is true once the account has any holding; the first import has happened then and
FirstImportDate no longer affects existing holdings (ADR 0013).

PortfolioTrackResult.description: What a track action did. `Requested` distinct master-list instruments were asked to be tracked, `Added` of them are newly tracked (or tracked again), `AlreadyTracked` were; `NotInMaster` open holdings in scope are not in the instrument master (nothing to track), `Retired` instruments are no longer listed and were skipped. `TotalTracked` is the number tracked now. No job is started: `Hint` says the next Update data builds the bars.

PositionRow.description:
One open position. string PositionRow.Protection is `confirmed` only when the broker's order book, read within TimeSpan ExecutionScreens.ProtectionReadLimit, was compared with our stop and showed no difference; `missing` when the engine raised a
protection breach; else `unknown`. string PositionRow.Source is `ours` or `foreign`; string PositionRow.Reconciliation is `matched`, `break`, `not_run` or `unavailable`.

PreviewBaselineView.description: The baseline a preview is about.

PreviewCsvFilesRequest.description: The files to preview: names from the folder listing, at most int PreviewCsvFilesHandler.MaxFiles.

PreviewEstimateView.description: The measured replay time the next job may be compared with: a value only after a job measured one.

PreviewRow.description:
A holding Dhan reports, for the first import in the portfolio settings. Key identifies it in the import request (the ISIN, otherwise "securityId:EXCHANGE").
Mapped is false when it is not in the instrument master. AlreadyImported: the account has the holding (open) already.
SuggestedDate is the date to pre-fill: the first import date, or the oldest lot's date of an already imported holding.

PriceAlertInput.description: A new price alert: the master-list share or ETF, `Direction``at_or_below|at_or_above`, the `Level` in rupees (above 0, at most 10,000,000, at most 4 decimals) and an optional plain-text `Note` of at most 200 characters.

PriceAlertPage.description: One page of alerts, newest first (`Total` counts all matches). `ActiveCount` of `ActiveLimit` alerts are active, whatever the filter.

PriceAlertView.description:
A price alert. `Status` is `active`, `triggered` (with `TriggeredAt` and `TriggerPrice`, the last price of the tick that hit the level) or `cancelled`. It is checked on the last price of each quotes tick only (every 5 minutes while the market
is open): a spike between two ticks is not seen.

PricesAsOf.description: The oldest and the newest time of the prices of the open holdings (null when none has a priced time).

items.description:
The latest known price of an instrument: `lastPrice` at `priceAt` (the time of the exchange's tick for `live`, the time of the quote for `quote`, the time of the sync for `sync`; UTC) and where it came from:
`live` (the live feed), `quote` (the 5-minute quote poll) or `sync` (the broker's holdings list). The same values as `lastPrice`, `priceAt` and `priceSource` of the holdings list. An older price never follows a newer one
for the same instrument; a client that gets one anyway ignores it.

PricesChanged.description:
Hub event `pricesChanged`: the prices that changed for the instruments the connection follows since the last message sent to it (the first messages after `Subscribe` carry all of them). At most one burst a second;
at most 500 instruments and 32 KB per message (a larger change comes as several messages with the same `asOf`). `asOf` is the server's time when it read the prices (UTC).

ProbeSeamSummary.description: One line per probed instrument; IReadOnlyList<string> ProbeSeamSummary.Lines is the text for the owner.

code.description: Stable machine-readable error code, e.g. auth.invalid_credentials, auth.locked, auth.session_expired, auth.csrf_invalid, auth.step_up_required, accounts.not_found, accounts.invalid (field errors in "errors"), accounts.conflict, accounts.app_not_configured, accounts.broker_error (502), accounts.connect_mismatch, accounts.consent_limit (429), accounts.connect_expired, accounts.connect_cancelled, portfolio.not_connected, portfolio.sync_running, portfolio.confirmation_required and portfolio.confirmation_stale (409, with listedHoldings, openHoldings and wouldClose), portfolio.conflict (409), portfolio.invalid, portfolio.not_found, portfolio.lot_from_trade (409), portfolio.preview_stale (409, with report), services.not_found (404), services.invalid (400, with issues), services.revision_changed (409), services.already_running (409), services.read_only (409), history.disabled, history.disk_low, history.calendar_missing, history.outside_window (422), history.run_active (409), history.no_target (404).

retryAfterSeconds.description: Present on auth.locked, auth.rate_limited and accounts.consent_limit: seconds until a new attempt may succeed.

openHoldings.description: Present on portfolio.confirmation_required and portfolio.confirmation_stale: how many holdings the account has open.

listedHoldings.description: Present on portfolio.confirmation_required and portfolio.confirmation_stale: how many holdings Dhan listed.

issues.description: Present on services.invalid: every error of the refused schedule - the service it is about (serviceId; absent for the service of the request), the field (a dotted path like the request, e.g. schedule.time, retries, parameters.x), severity (error), a stable code and the text.

report.description: Present on portfolio.preview_stale: the fresh preview of the file, in the shape of the response of POST /api/portfolio/trades/preview (TradePreviewReport).

wouldClose.description: Present on portfolio.confirmation_required: how many of them the sync would close because Dhan no longer lists them.

ProfileBasketView.description: The basket: `Kind` is manual, portfolio, index, list or derived; `ParamsHash` only for a derived basket.

ProfileBreadthView.description: Breadth inside the basket on the last session with a bar; `SeriesB20` is the share above the 20-day average per day (null where too few voted).

ProfileCapacityView.description: What the basket can absorb: the ADV20 (the CF-05 median of traded value, in rupees) of the members, a share of it as capacity and the flag shares. A member with fewer than 20 sessions of volume is listed, never guessed.

ProfileContributionView.description: Who made the return: the five largest and five smallest parts, the share of the three largest and every member (empty unless the shares exist).

ProfileCorrelationView.description: Average pairwise correlation, the effective number of bets (a heuristic) and the matrix of the most liquid members (null when there is no correlation figure).

ProfileDispersionView.description: Dispersion of member returns on the last session, its mean over 20 sessions and the interquartile range.

ProfileExclusionView.description: An instrument left out and why.

ProfileHoldOutCellView.description: One strategy's cell: the n and the expectancy of each half and the verdict (agrees, disagrees, insufficient, not_evaluable).

ProfileHoldOutView.description: The median split of the strategy trades of the basket in the default run set (m23): not the locked hold-out of ADR 0207. `Status` says whether trades could be read.

ProfileIndexView.description: The index in force: null symbol when there is none.

ProfileMembersView.description: Instruments in the basket in the window (`Total`), the ones the figures rest on (`Counted`) and every one left out with its reason (no_bars, starts_late, ends_early, discontinuity, bad_price, too_few_bars).

ProfileRegimeView.description: The regime panel: `Status` is a value when a regime was recorded, else why not; `Unknown` days sit in no row.

ProfileRiskView.description: Risk figures (fractions, not percent). Alpha, tracking error and information ratio are those of the 252-day window; `Alpha` is the regression intercept against the index, not a trading result.

ProfileSeriesView.description: The series of the charts, one entry per index date. The basket and the index are rebased to 100 on the first date; an entry without a value is null (the index has no bar that day), never zero.

password.description: The owner's password, re-entered for THIS act. Missing: 403 auth.step_up_required; wrong: 401, counted toward the lockout.

PromoteModelRequest.description: The body of a promotion. The owner is never part of it: the actor comes from the signed-in session.

changed.description: False when it was champion already and nothing was written.

PromotionRequestBody.description: The owner's request for the next mode. The actor is never taken from the body.

PromptView.description: One post-trade prompt with its derived status (open, matched, expired_no_fill, ambiguous) and, when matched, how (journal or trade_on_record). `sameTradeItems` names the other tickets of an ambiguous prompt.

ProposalCheck.description: One engine check of a proposal: a stable id, whether it passed, and the detail in words.

ProposalDecisionView.description: The decision on a proposal. Auto is true for the auto option: such a decision is never an owner approval.

ProposalEvidence.description: The evidence of a proposal (AC 3): basis, population run keys, date range, n, figures with states and the honest limits. Built by the engine from the references, never from the model's text.

ProposalKnobView.description: The knob of a hypothesis proposal.

ProposalPayloadView.description: The payload as the API shows it: the fields of the kind are set, the others are null.

ProposalView.description: One proposal as the API shows it (spec P9-08 Contract). The text fields are text: a screen renders them as text.

baselineRunKey.description: The stored run the hypothesis is attached to (64 lower-case hex).

window.description: The window of the link: `all` (the default), `250d` or `60d`.

password.description: The owner's password, typed again for THIS act and checked on every request.

ProposeFromUniverseLinkRequest.description: The body of the owner act that proposes a hypothesis from a stable liquidity-tier observation (BK-11b): the stored baseline run, the owner's reason, the window of the link (default all) and the password. The actor is the session's owner; nothing here names it.

QualityBucketRow.description: A bucket stored and recomputed side by side; `fields` name what differs (open, high, low, close, volume, bars) or `missing` / `unexpected`; `stored` or `recomputed` is null when there is none.

QualityBucketValues.description: The values of a bucket: open, high, low, close, volume and the number of 1-minute bars in it.

QualityBuckets.description:
The stored and the recomputed buckets of the window, computed when asked (`computedAt`), so they show the state now, whatever the last run saw. `total` and `differences` count all buckets of the
request's timeframe filter; `items` are cut at 2000 (`truncated`); with `differencesOnly` only the differing ones are listed.

QualityCheckResults.description: The checks of one instrument as the last run found them (without the long lists, which the detail gives separately).

QualityCheckStatuses.description: The status of each check of an instrument: pass · warning · fail · notAvailable (`officialDaily`).

QualityCounts.description:
The current results over the tracked instruments that have bars: how many there are (`tracked`), how many were `checked` (have a result), the counts by result, `notChecked`, and the mean score
of the results (null before the first run). The current result of an instrument is the one of the latest run that checked it.

QualityGateView.description:
The gate for the nightly plan (fail-closed). `blocked`: no run yet, the last run over every instrument failed, or more than `maxFailedPercent` of the checked instruments fail;
`ok`: not blocked and no instrument fails; `reasons` says why it is not ok. Instruments that fail individually are skipped by the scan whatever the gate says.

QualityInstrumentDetail.description:
One instrument's quality: the current result (`status` pass · warning · fail · notChecked, `score`, `checks` from the run `runId` at `checkedAt`), the missing minutes of that run
and the stored-vs-recomputed buckets as they are now.

QualityInstrumentRow.description:
An instrument in the quality table. `status`: pass · warning · fail · notChecked (never checked). `coverage` is the share of the expected minutes that are stored (percent); `aggregates` gives the status
of each timeframe (5m … 1M); `checks` the status of each check; `issues` says in words what is wrong; `source`: csv · dhan · mixed.

QualityMissing.description: The missing minutes of the window: `total` of them, and the first `items` (at most 500; `truncated` when there are more).

QualityOverview.description:
What the Data quality screen shows above the table: `lastRun` (the latest run over every instrument, null before the first), the `counts` of the current results with the mean `score`,
the `gate`, the `window`, the limits in force (`spikeMultiple`, `maxMissingPercent`) and `pendingCorporateActions`: the suggested splits and bonus issues waiting for the owner (ADR 0017 §5).

QualityPhase.description:
The quality phase of a data job (P1-14a): `Done` of `Total` are instruments checked. `RunId` is the quality run it recorded
(`/api/data/quality/runs`); `Passed`, `Warned` and `Failed` count the instruments by result so far. Part of the API (the job's
`quality` block, present only when the job asked for the step).

QualityRunView.description:
One run of the data quality checks. `trigger`: manual · daily (the scheduled end-of-day run) · after_job (a data job the owner started with the quality step). `status`: running · succeeded · failed.
`instruments` is how many the run checks, `passed`, `warned` and `failed` how many it has checked so far with that result; `score` is the mean (0–100, once it ended).
`instrumentId` is set when the run checked one instrument only (a fix action); `jobId` is the data job it belongs to.

QualityWindowView.description: The window of the checks: how many closed sessions, from which date to which (the ones a run started now would look at).

accountId.description: The account the ticket is already sized for.

quantity.description: The new quantity (at least 1, below the allocated one).

QuantityChangeRequest.description: A lower size for one account of the ticket.

QuarterView.description: The out-of-sample trades of one calendar quarter that had at least one trade (SC-S1, ADR 0222).

QueueItem.description: An accepted hypothesis waiting; nothing was applied.

note.description: Accepted means judged better offline; nothing was applied; applying it starts a new epoch.

truncated.description: True when the 200 newest accepted hypotheses were read and there may be more.

QueueView.description: The queue of accepted hypotheses that no change names.

password.description: The owner's password, re-entered for THIS act (checked on every request; no step-up window is used).

RampActRequest.description: The body of clearing a hold or recording the exit confirmation (spec P11-04): the account, a reason and the owner's password for THIS act.

kind.description: set_step, auto_step_up, hold, clear_hold, step_down or exit_confirmed.

fromStep.description: The step before; null for the first.

gateHash.description: The hash of the frozen gate snapshot of a raise on evidence; null for the other kinds.

RampEventView.description: One event of the ramp history.

RampGateView.description: One evidence gate as the screen reads it. `number` is null when the state says it could not be measured.

scaleEffective.description: The factor in force; null with no step.

nextStep.description: The step a raise would reach; null at S3 or with no step.

eligible.description: All evidence gates G1 to G6 pass.

intendedRiskPct.description: The risk per trade of the profile (with the account's override), percent of capital; null when not known.

liveRiskPct.description: The intended risk times the scale.

writesEnabled.description: Whether the web may write the ramp now (`Live:Writes:Enabled`).

notice.description: No setting lets this system place an order.

gates.description: G1 to G7 of the current step, each with its state, number, threshold and n; empty with no step. G7 is information.

breaches.description: The breach rules that fire on the evidence now.

holdConditions.description: What still holds a hold (a clear is refused while any is listed).

oneOf.description: The loss of today as measured now; null with no step or no capital.

halts.description: The halts of the last 30 days, newest first.

slippageKind.description: The reference kind G3 was measured on.

autoRampUp.description: `live.auto_ramp_up` in force (S1 to S2 by rule when every gate passes).

exitConfirmed.description: The owner has recorded the exit confirmation S3 needs.

RampView.description:
