candidates.description: Candidates dated in the window, summed over the timeframes.

blocked.description: Candidates blocked by the filter (under the threshold or unknown).

thresholdCrore.description: The threshold the run used, in crore rupees.

share.description: The share of the candidates blocked; 0 when there were none.

TurnoverExclusionView.description:
What the filter `min_turnover` left out of a Lab verdict (CF-05, ADR 0230): candidates whose 20-day median traded value was under the threshold or unknown have no trade, so the trades behind the verdict are the survivors of a liquidity filter, not a clean tier sample.
Present only for a strategy that names the filter (null otherwise, so the stored JSON of every other verdict is unchanged). Counts only; the candidates are those of the first exit of every timeframe, which every exit candidate shares.

UnderlyingArchiveSummary.description: One underlying of the option archive: recorded and usable chain sessions, the first and last recorded date, the gaps by outcome, the backfill keys and the half-spread model state. Counts and dates only; no price, IV or Greek.

UngroundedSpan.description: A figure of the answer that the tool results do not hold: its place in the text (UTF-16 code units, End exclusive) and the text itself.

readKey.description: The key a reader takes: the child's when it is better, else the parent's.

childLower.description: The tier cell's lower credible bound of the win rate.

parentLower.description: The parent's bound without the child's trades; null when the child is thin.

observation.description: True when the tier is read in place of the parent and has at least the link minimum of trades: an observation to show, never applied.

holdOut.description: `stable` (the tier's lower bound beats the rest of the parent's in both halves of its trades), `unstable`, `insufficient` (a half has fewer than 30 trades) or `not_evaluated` (a row stored before it); computed when the cells were computed.

holdOutFirstN.description: Tier trades in the first half; null when not evaluated.

holdOutSecondN.description: Tier trades in the second half; null when not evaluated.

text.description: The sentence the Setups view shows.

UniverseLinkView.description: One tier cell read against its all-shares parent (BK-11, criteria 5, 6 and 11).

UniverseSettingsChangeBody.description: The body of a change of the universe settings; a value left out stays.

version.description: The newest change id (0 when none); a change names it as `expectedVersion`.

notice.description: What the settings do and do not do.

autoPropose.description: `learning.universe_link.auto_propose` (BK-11b): off by default; when on, observations are proposed as hypotheses by the actor auto. Proposes only.

UniverseSettingsView.description: The universe settings in force with their history (BK-11).

UniverseTrialsView.description: The baskets a strategy was tested on and how many variants they add (information only, BK-11).

UnmatchedEntry.description: An entry that named no instrument. `reason`: `not_found` · `ambiguous` (an ISIN of several instruments) · `invalid` (too long or with control characters).

UnpairedCountView.description: The trades of a run that did not pair, by reason.

group.description: The cell (its figures are non-values; only its count is a number).

UnrankedCellView.description: A cell that was looked at and is not in the ranking, listed after the ranked ones with the reason, never hidden.

UntrackResult.description: What an untrack call did: `untracked` were tracked, `notTracked` were not (nothing to do). `totalTracked` is the number tracked now.

UpdateCorporateActionRequest.description:
Changes an action and makes it applied (confirming a suggestion, bringing back an ignored one). Every field is optional and keeps its current value when left out (an empty body confirms as it is);
`note` left out keeps the note, an empty text clears it. `acknowledgeCsvAdjusted` as when adding: needed when the result is applied with an ex-date on or before `csvAdjustedThrough`.

UpdateSecretsInput.description:
Replaces the account's API key and/or secret (write-only). A value that is left out stays as it is; an empty one is invalid.
ApiKeyIssuedOn is the day the key was generated: it defaults to today when a new API key is given and can also be corrected on its own.

ValidateStrategyRequest.description: Body of `POST /api/lab/validate`: the strategy text and its format (only `yaml`; omitted means yaml).

VariantSeriesRowView.description: One variant's daily series (net R by exit date, rounded to 4 places) and who it is: `base` or the swept parameter and value.

VariantSeriesView.description: The daily series PBO was computed from (CF-03 part B): one value per variant per date, so the figure can be recomputed from the stored document. Null when the PBO mode is Off or a daily value was not finite.

VersionScoreView.description: A ranked instrument of a version: members and the next non-members by rank (the "why").

VersionSummary.description: A stored version in the list of a family: number, hash, parent hash, note and creation time.

dimensions.description: The dimensions a cell is made of.

ranked.description: Cells with enough sample whose lower bound could be formed, best first.

notRanked.description: Every other cell, most trades first.

cellsComparable.description: Cells that compete: every coordinate recorded and the base minimum of trades.

requiredTrades.description: The sample a cell needs to be ranked, raised with the number of cells compared.

largestN.description: The most trades in any cell.

positiveLowerBound.description: Ranked cells with a positive lower bound.

expectedChancePositives.description: About how many positive lower bounds chance alone gives among the ranked cells.

selectionNote.description: The selection-effect sentence that always accompanies a ranking.

unavailableDimensions.description: Dimensions left out of the cells because nothing recorded them, with the reason.

nonAdditive.description: A trade is in more than one cell.

WhatWorksView.description:
"What works, in which basket, on which timeframe, with which exit": the cells with enough sample ranked by the credible lower bound of expectancy, the rest after them with the reason, how many cells were looked at, and when no cell qualifies the answer
`nothing_qualifies` with the counts. An answer, not an error.

tags.description: Its tags with the numbers behind each.

YearView.description: The out-of-sample trades of one calendar year.
